entry.title: Garment Particles: A 2D--3D Symmetric Garment Representation for Generation and Editing

author.name: Kiyohiro Nakayama, I-chao Shen, Ruofan Liu, Yiming Wang, Gordon Wetzstein, Takeo Igarashi

entry.summary: Garment Particles is a 5D point-cloud representation jointly encoding 2D sewing patterns and 3D draped geometry, enabling both intuitive generation from images/text and precise low-level pattern editing via rectified flow.

entry.title: PhyPush: One Push is All You Need for Sensorless Physical Property Estimation with Physics-Guided Transformers

author.name: Koyo Fujii, Luis Figueredo, Praminda Caleb-Solly, Ivan Boschi, Edoardo Ida', Marco Carricato, Aly Magassouba

entry.summary: PhyPush estimates object mass and friction from a single robot push using only end-effector velocity and a physics-guided Transformer that incorporates Newtons second law and Coulomb friction constraints. Eliminates need for force/torque or tactile sensing.

entry.title: Provably Safe Motion Planning Under Unknown Disturbances

author.name: Ibon Gracia, Qi Heng Ho, Luca Laurenti, Morteza Lahijanian

entry.summary: Sampling-based motion planning algorithm with provable safety under random disturbances of unknown distribution. Learns Wasserstein ambiguity tubes from data to constrain trajectory distributions with high confidence.

entry.title: Enabling Extensible Embodied Capabilities with Tools

author.name: Xueyang Zhou, Zijia Wang, Qianjiang Li, Yibo Hu, Guiyao Tie, Li Wan, Yidan Liu, Pan Zhou, Lichao Sun, Yongchao Chen

entry.summary: Embodied Tool Protocol decouples heterogeneous embodied capabilities (perception, reasoning, planning, control) into independently optimized tools invoked at inference time. Curates 100+ validated tools as a base for tool-calling embodied agents.

entry.title: Breaking the Epistemic Trap: Active Perception Under Compound Uncertainty

author.name: Chayan Banerjee, Ethan Goan

entry.summary: Identifies the Epistemic Trap in safety-critical RL, where unknown dynamics and incomplete observations interact synergistically to cause failures worse than either alone (77 vs 46 percent degradation). Proposes active perception to break the trap.

entry.title: Diverse reasoning traces teach LLMs to make better decisions

author.name: Unknown

entry.summary: Amazon Science blog post on using diverse parallel reasoning traces during supervised fine-tuning to expand LLM reasoning capacity. Presented at ICLR; addresses pitfalls of single-trace SFT.

entry.title: Import AI 458: Reckoning with the future; and a singularity story

author.name: Jack Clark

entry.summary: Jack Clark essay framing AI progress as a choice between exploring the future or retreating from the present, plus a fictional positive-singularity story. Based on the 2026 Cosmos HAI Lab Lecture at Oxford.

entry.title: Deep learning of 777 K bulk transcriptomes reveals human–mouse gene conservation beyond DNA sequence similarity

author.name: Unknown

entry.summary: Nature Communications Biology paper using deep learning on 777,000 bulk transcriptomes to reveal human-mouse gene conservation patterns that go beyond DNA sequence similarity.

entry.title: Scoring gene importance by interpreting single-cell foundation models

author.name: Unknown

entry.summary: A Nature Biotechnology paper proposing an interpretability method that scores gene importance by analyzing single-cell foundation models. It bridges ML interpretability with functional genomics, potentially helping biologists extract actionable insights from large pretrained transcriptomic models.

entry.title: Personalizing Embodied Multimodal Large Language Model Agents over Long-term User Interactions

author.name: Jeongeun Lee, Chanyoung Park, Dongha Lee

entry.summary: POLAR is a multimodal memory-augmented framework for embodied agents that personalizes assistance using knowledge graphs combining semantic and episodic memory from long-term user interactions. Targets implicit user-intent resolution in physical environments.

entry.title: Exploiting Local Dynamics Regularity for Reusable Skills in Offline Hierarchical RL

author.name: Sarthak Dayal, Abhinav Peri, Carl Qi, Claas Voelcker, Alexander Levine, Caleb Chuck, Amy Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes exploiting local dynamics regularity for learning reusable skills in offline hierarchical RL, leveraging the intuition that similar local transitions across global contexts require similar action sequences. Aligns contexts with action sequences for skill reuse.

entry.title: MobileExplorer: Accelerating On-Device Inference for Mobile GUI Agents via Online Exploration

author.name: Runxi Huang, Liyu Zhang, Shengzhong Liu, Xiaomin Ouyang

entry.summary: MobileExplorer accelerates on-device inference for vision-based mobile GUI agents by exploiting long VLM reasoning time to perform lightweight parallel exploration of UI elements during model inference. Addresses cloud-dependency and privacy issues of GUI agents.

entry.title: LiveK12Bench: Have Large Multimodal Models Truly Conquered High School-level Examinations?

author.name: Xiaohan Wang, Mingze Yin, Yilin Zhao, Gang Liu, Dian Li

entry.summary: LiveK12Bench is a dynamic, holistic, multi-disciplinary benchmark of 2000+ verified questions for evaluating large multimodal models on high-school examination reasoning, designed to resist contamination and cover multiple modalities.

entry.title: Query Symbolically or Retrieve Semantically? A Dataset and Method for Semi-Structured Question Answering

author.name: Mateusz Czy\.znikiewicz, Ryszard Tuora, Adam Kozakiewicz, Tomasz Zi\k{e}tkiewicz, Mateusz Gali\'nski, Micha{\l} Godziszewski, Micha{\l} Karpowicz, Timothy Hospedales, Cristina Cornelio

entry.summary: DualGraph is a RAG framework with dual textual and symbolic knowledge graph views, enabling both semantic retrieval and symbolic querying over typed subject-predicate-object triples for semi-structured QA requiring filtering, aggregation, or exhaustive retrieval.

entry.title: MUSE-Autoskill: Self-Evolving Agents via Skill Creation, Memory, Management, and Evaluation

author.name: Huawei Lin, Peng Li, Jie Song, Fuxin Jiang, Tieying Zhang

entry.summary: MUSE-Autoskill is a skill-centric agent framework with unified lifecycle (creation, memory, management, evaluation, refinement) enabling agents to continuously improve task-solving capability through reusable, refined skills.

entry.title: Max-Window Scale Estimation for Near-Lossless HiF8 W8A8 Quantization-Aware Training

author.name: Yingying Cheng, Jinquan Shi, Li Zhou, Zhiyang He, Zhaoyi Sun, Fan Zhang, Jie Sun

entry.summary: Systematic study of HiF8 W8A8 quantization-aware training failure modes in OpenPangu-Embedded-1B, identifying amax saturation and catastrophic forgetting as orthogonal issues invisible to standard training loss. Proposes max-window scale estimation as a remedy.

entry.title: Auditing and Fixing Economic Validity in Tabular Foundation Models for Discrete Choice

author.name: Yingshuo Wang, Xian Sun, Yanhang Li, Zhichao Fan, Zexin Zhuang

entry.summary: Audits tabular foundation models for economic validity in choice prediction, finding violations like demand increasing with price. Proposes a two-stage adapter combining utility-maximization constraints with foundation model corrections.

entry.title: Learning Energy-Based Models from Stochastic Interpolants using Spatiotemporal Differences

author.name: Hanlin Yu, RuiKang OuYang, Partha Kaushik, Arto Klami, Michael U. Gutmann, Omar Chehab

entry.summary: Introduces Spatiotemporal Noise-Contrastive Estimation (stNCE), a framework for learning energy-based models using both spatial and temporal differences from stochastic interpolants. Unifies existing methods and produces new training objectives.

entry.title: Adversarial Dual On-Policy Distillation from Expressive Flow-based Teacher

author.name: Zhenglin Wan, Jingxuan Wu, Xingrui Yu, Chubin Zhang, Mingcong Lei, Bo An, Ivor W. Tsang, Yang You

entry.summary: Proposes FA-OPD, an adversarial dual on-policy distillation method that learns a flow-matching teacher from demonstrations co-trained with an MLP student. Addresses the lack of fixed expert teachers in demonstration-only embodied control.

entry.title: Symbolic Regression via Latent Iterative Refinement

author.name: Xieting Chu, Sriram Vishwanath, Vijay Ganesh

entry.summary: Proposes LEE, a symbolic regression framework using iterative amortized inference in a functionally-grounded latent space shared by symbolic tokens and numerical observations. Closes the amortization gap between one-shot prediction and true posterior.

entry.title: Beyond Differences: Doubly Robust Meta-Learners for Ratio-Based Treatment Effects

author.name: Michael Fuchs, Dominik Kreiss

entry.summary: Introduces the Q-Learner for ratio-based conditional average treatment effects, decomposing tau(x) into a product of odds ratios reducing the problem to two propensity classification tasks. Derives doubly robust augmentations and benchmarks on seven RCT datasets.

entry.title: Not All Tokens Matter Equally: Dynamic In-context Vector Distillation with Decisive-Token Supervision for Long-form Medical Report Generation

author.name: Ning Wu, Rui Liu, Xinkun Lin, Weixing Chen, Jinxi Xiang, Tao Wei, Lina Yao, Mingjie Li

entry.summary: Proposes dynamic in-context vector distillation with decisive-token supervision for long-form medical report generation. Addresses the limitation that token-level distillation treats template tokens equally while important pathology and end-of-sequence tokens are sparse.

entry.title: Towards Just-in-Time Adaptive Feedback: Enhancing Student Learning via Knowledge-Grounded LLM

author.name: Younghun Lee, Amir Bralin, Nobel Sanjay Rebello, Dan Goldwasser

entry.summary: Presents a knowledge-grounded LLM framework for just-in-time adaptive feedback in education, deployed in a large university course with over 1000 students. Reports improved student performance through error analysis and non-intrusive feedback.

entry.title: KARMA: Karma-Aligned Reward Model Adaptation

author.name: Jared Scott, Jesse Roberts

entry.summary: KARMA trains a reward model on Reddit conversations to capture context-sensitive conversational norms and tone, then uses it for RL fine-tuning of pragmatics tasks. Finds the best reward model does not yield the best downstream alignment.

entry.title: Optimising Factual Consistency in Summarisation via Preference Learning from Multiple Imperfect Metrics

author.name: Yuxuan Ye, Raul Santos-Rodriguez, Edwin Simpson

entry.summary: Aggregates scores from multiple weak factuality metrics into preference labels for RL-based summarization training. Filters out high-disagreement cases and maps scores to preferences without complex reward shaping.

entry.title: ExTax: Explainable Disinformation Detection via Persuasion, Emotion, and Narrative Role Taxonomies

author.name: Shang Luo, Yingguang Yang, Zhenchen Sun, Yang Liu, Bin Chong, Jingru Chen, Yancheng Chen, Jiayu Liang, Kefu Xu, Hao Peng, Philip S. Yu

entry.summary: ExTax is an explainable disinformation detection framework using taxonomies of persuasion strategies, emotion appeals, and narrative roles. Targets multi-faceted manipulative intents beyond syntax-semantics with human-auditable explanations.

entry.title: ENPMR-Bench: Benchmarking Proactive Memory Retrieval for Emotional Support Agents

author.name: Xing Fu, Yulin Hu, Mengtong Ji, Haozhen Li, Yixin Sun, Weixiang Zhao, Yanyan Zhao, Bing Qin

entry.summary: ENPMR-Bench evaluates Emotional Need-aware Proactive Memory Retrieval for memory-augmented agents grounded in Maslow's hierarchy of needs. Contains over 1,800 memory-augmented dialogues with structured emotional-need mappings.

entry.title: Sparse-LiDAR Prompting of Monocular Geometry Foundations: An Empirical Study Toward Long-Range Driving Depth

author.name: Kai Zheng, Qiang Feng, Xingjian Liu, Wenquan Tan, Yuan Li

entry.summary: SLIM adapts the MoGe-2 point-map foundation model to accept truly sparse LiDAR input via a partial-convolution sparse encoder and multi-scale fusion neck, with systematic evaluation in long-range 50-150m driving regimes. Extends LiDAR-prompted depth estimation beyond standard 80m benchmarks.

entry.title: Self-Intersection-Aware 3D Human Motion Generation Using an Efficient Human Sphere Proxy

author.name: Pascal Herrmann, Maarten Bieshaar, Dennis Mack, Robert Herzog, Juergen Gall

entry.summary: Introduces an efficient sphere-proxy self-intersection loss for human motion generation that runs 98% faster and uses 83% less memory than alternatives. Targets the prevalent self-intersection artifacts in state-of-the-art motion synthesis.

entry.title: SoftCap: Soft-Budget Control for Diffusion Transformer Acceleration

author.name: Yuhang Zhang, Junxiang Qiu, Huixia Ben, Zhenhua Tang, Shuo Wang, Yanbin Hao

entry.summary: SoftCap is a training-free PI-controller for cache-based diffusion transformer inference that adaptively decides when to perform full vs cached steps using trajectory drift estimates. Provides soft-budget control for acceleration.

entry.title: Mind the Tool Failures: Achieving Synergistic Tool Gains for Medical Agents

author.name: Yunhui Gan, Tan Pan, Kaiyu Guo, Limei Han, Weimiao Yu, Guangnan Ye, Chen Jiang, Yuan Cheng

entry.summary: Studies medical tool use under imperfect-tool settings where even relevant tools fail on challenging instances, identifying a Single-Oracle risk gap between best fixed tool and instance-wise selectors. Proposes synergistic tool selection for medical agents.

entry.title: Towards Feedback-to-Plan Decisions for Self-Evolving LLM Agents in CUDA Kernel Generation

author.name: Yee Hin Chong, Jiaming Wu, Youhui Zhang, Peng Qu

entry.summary: CUDAnalyst is a controlled analysis layer for self-evolving CUDA kernel generation agents that uses trajectory freezing and selective feedback injection to attribute planning decisions to specific feedback components.

entry.title: Neuro-Symbolic Verification of LLM Outputs for Data-Sensitive Domains (extended preprint)

author.name: Paul Sigloch, Christoph Benzm\"uller

entry.summary: Hybrid verification architecture combining formal symbolic methods (for input verification with decidable guarantees) and neural semantic analysis (for output validation via embedding similarity) to address hallucinations and inconsistencies in LLMs for data-sensitive domains.

entry.title: Can Broad Biomedical Knowledge be Contextualized into Scenario-Grounded Propositions?

author.name: Qingyuan Zeng, Ziyang Chen, Pengxiang Cai, Zixin Guan, Anglin Liu, Lang Qin, Xinyao Lai, Jintai Chen

entry.summary: SCENE is a bi-level multi-agent framework treating biomedical knowledge contextualization as iterative search, converting broad knowledge into search directions grounded in dataset schemas to produce scenario-grounded propositions experts can validate.

entry.title: The Compressive Knowledge Graph Hypothesis: Which Graph Facts Matter for Scientific Hypothesis Generation?

author.name: Shashwat Sourav, Viktoriia Baibakova, Sanjay Das, Ran Elgedawy, Maria Mahbub, Emily Herron, Tirthankar Ghosal

entry.summary: Studies KG-guided hypothesis generation for battery materials across Mistral-7B, Llama-3.1-70B, and Gemini 2.5 Flash, finding KG utility is selective and model-dependent and that compact top-k subgraphs often approximate full-KG behavior.

entry.title: Planning Neural Dynamics with Lie Group Embedding through Supervised Projective Manifold Learning

author.name: Tianwei Wang, Bryan Chen, Qian Zuo, Qiyue Xia, Xin Li, Wei Pang

entry.summary: LieEDNN embeds Lie groups (SO(3), SE(3)) as intrinsic representations within neural networks for stable dynamics on smooth manifolds, addressing incompatibility between Lie groups and addition arithmetic. Targets robotics, graphics, and control applications.

entry.title: AgentSociety: Incentivizing Agentic Social Intelligence

author.name: Aditya Vema Reddy Kesari, Krishna Reddy Kesari

entry.summary: AgentSociety proposes a decentralized multi-agent collaboration mechanism grounded in liquid democracy and information diffusion from social choice theory, with economic incentives for agentic social intelligence. Aims for human-society-like multi-agent environments.

entry.title: BioFact-MoE: Biologically Factorized Mixture of Experts for Vision-Language Prognostic Modeling in Hepatocellular Carcinoma

author.name: Junlin Yang, Tian Yu, Nicha C. Dvornek, Yuexi Du, Peiyu Duan, Annabella Shewarega, Lawrence H. Staib, James S. Duncan, Julius Chapiro

entry.summary: BioFact-MoE is a biologically factorized Mixture of Experts vision-language framework for HCC prognostic modeling that explicitly decomposes liver and tumor factors via biological priors. Targets accurate and interpretable survival prediction.

entry.title: DDGAD: Trajectory Dynamics for Diffusion-Based Graph Anomaly Detection

author.name: Yuxin Yang, Limei Hu, Feng Chen

entry.summary: DDGAD is a diffusion-based graph anomaly detection framework using trajectory dynamics to distinguish normal from anomalous nodes, addressing contamination propagation in GCN-based methods where anomalies pollute neighbor representations via message passing.

entry.title: Cross-scale Aligned Supervision for Training GANs

author.name: Sangeek Hyun, MinKyu Lee, Jae-Pil Heo

entry.summary: Argues that standard scale-wise adversarial supervision in GANs does not construct a proper coarse-to-fine hierarchy because each intermediate image is independently pushed toward real distribution at its scale without enforcing identity across stages. Proposes cross-scale aligned supervision as a corrective.

entry.title: AnchorDiff: Training-Free Concept Grounding for MM-DiTs via Anchor-Based Graph Propagation

author.name: Jian Zhang, Zhijun Zhang

entry.summary: AnchorDiff is a training-free concept grounding method for multi-modal diffusion transformers that selects high-confidence attention anchors and propagates them via image-to-image self-attention graphs to address concept leakage between visually confusable concepts.

entry.title: DGLD: Domain-Gated Latent Diffusion for the Discovery of Novel Energetic Materials

author.name: Yehudit Aperstein, Alexander Apartsin

entry.summary: DGLD applies domain-gated latent diffusion to discover novel energetic materials, addressing sparse-label challenges in CHNO molecule design. The pipeline yielded 12 DFT-confirmed novel leads in a 15-year-stagnant field.

entry.title: Bilevel Optimization over Saddle Points of Zero-Sum Markov Games

author.name: Zihao Zheng, Irwin King, Songtao Lu

entry.summary: Bilevel optimization framework for zero-sum Markov games where the lower level is a min-max game rather than single-policy MDP. Proposes PANDA algorithm for incentive design and competitive RL settings.

entry.title: Self-Improvement Imitation with Biologically Guided Search for Protein Design Under Oracle Budgets

author.name: Ashima Khanna, Dominik Grimm

entry.summary: SILO is a trajectory-level self-improvement imitation framework for protein design under tight oracle budgets, using hierarchical edit policies for position and residue choices. Combines stochastic beam search with UCB-based proxy ensembles.

entry.title: SL-BiLEM: Structured Learnable Behavior-in-the-Loop Epidemic Modeling for Forecasting and Policy Evaluation

author.name: Haochun Wang, Sendong Zhao, Jingbo Wang, Yanrui Du, Bing Qin, Ting Liu

entry.summary: SL-BiLEM uses physics-constrained learnable behavior dynamics for epidemic forecasting under distribution shifts at policy intervention points. Decomposes effective transmission into interpretable multiplicative factors.

entry.title: L2Rec: Towards Dual-View Understanding of LLMs for Personalized Recommendation

author.name: Pingjun Pan, Tingting Zhou, Peiyao Lu, Tingting Fei, Hongxiang Chen, Chuanjiang Luo

entry.summary: L2Rec unifies behavioral and semantic understanding for LLM-based recommendation at the parameter level rather than at input or output. Uses shared transformer parameters as common medium for both views.

entry.title: ContextGuard: Structured Self-Auditing for Context Learning in Language Models

author.name: Hongbo Jin, Chi Wang, Haoran Tang, Zhongjing Du, Xu Jiang, Jingqi Tian, Qiaoman Zhang, Jiayu Ding

entry.summary: ContextGuard addresses partial reasoning failures where LLMs follow main reasoning but miss peripheral or format-sensitive contextual requirements. Proposes structured self-auditing for context learning.

entry.title: The Kalman Evolve: Closing the Gap in Kalman Filtering via Interpretable Algorithm Discovery

author.name: Vasileios Saketos, Ming Xiao

entry.summary: Kalman Evolve discovers improved filtering algorithms by jointly optimizing noise parameters and the algorithm itself in interpretable form. Addresses gap when linear-Gaussian Kalman assumptions fail in nonlinear sensing settings.

entry.title: Periodic Topological Deep Learning for Polymer Design and Discovery

author.name: Yasharth Yadav, Tze Kwang Gerald Er, Atsushi Goto, Kelin Xia

entry.summary: Periodic-TDL uses periodic Vietoris-Rips complexes and hierarchical simplicial message passing to model many-body interactions in polymers. Captures chain periodicity missing from single-repeat-unit graph approaches.

entry.title: Practical Anonymous Two-Party Gradient Boosting Decision Tree

author.name: Huang Chenyu, Zhang Fan, Du Minxin, Chow Sherman SM, Chen Huangxun, Rao Huaming, Huang Danqing, Qian Bo, Chen Peng

entry.summary: Anonymous two-party gradient boosting framework that hides record IDs unlike PSI-based approaches. Addresses privacy leakage in vertically partitioned GBDT training.

entry.title: EEG-FM-Audit: A Systematic Evaluation and Analysis Pipeline for EEG Foundation Models

author.name: Xianheng Wang, Yige Yang, Damien Coyle

entry.summary: EEG-FM-Audit is an evaluation pipeline for EEG foundation models with ASHA-driven baseline tuning, paradigm-level ablations, and decision transparency analysis. Addresses opacity in EEG-FM benchmarking.

entry.title: DEI: Diversity in Evolutionary Inference for Quality-Diversity Search

author.name: John Donaghy, Shikhar Rastogi

entry.summary: DEI uses heterogeneous LLMs as mutation operators in a distributed quality-diversity evolutionary search, leveraging different models' creative priors as complementary novelty sources. Evaluated on Core War coevolution benchmarks.

entry.title: Semantic Robustness Probing via Inpainting: An Interactive Tool for Safety-Critical Object Detection

author.name: Nico Steckhan, Krutarth Prajapati, Weija Shao, Silvia Vock

entry.summary: SemProbe is an interactive tool that uses diffusion-based controlled inpainting to generate semantically meaningful robustness probes for object detectors in safety-critical settings. Enables systematic before/after evaluation with logged artifacts.

entry.title: LitSeg: Narrative-Aware Document Segmentation for Literary RAG

author.name: Ruikang Zhang, Zhanni Chen, Yiqiao Cai, Qi Su

entry.summary: LitSeg proposes narrative-theory-guided document segmentation for literary RAG that extracts events, untangles narrative threads, and locates turning points. Addresses limitations of semantically blind chunking on complex literary structure.

entry.title: PilotTTS: A Disciplined Modular Recipe for Competitive Speech Synthesis

author.name: Bowen Li, Shaotong Guo, Zhen Wang, Yang Xiang, Mingli Jin, Yihang Lin, Jiahui Zhao, Weibo Xiong, Dongrui Li, Keming Chen, Yunze Gao, Yuze Zhou, Zeyang Lin, Yue Liu

entry.summary: PilotTTS demonstrates competitive autoregressive TTS using only 200K hours of open-source-processed data with Q-Former-based speaker conditioning. Targets reproducibility and accessibility for resource-constrained teams.

entry.title: When Rule Violations Are Rare: Chimera Training for Logical Anomaly Detection

author.name: Alejandro Ascarate, Leo Lebrat, Rodrigo Santa Cruz, Clinton Fookes, Olivier Salvado

entry.summary: Chimera Training is a neural rule evaluator that compiles logical constraints over visual concepts into DAGs with feature-aware MLP gates for logical anomaly detection when rule violations are rare. Enables intermediate supervision via Boolean propagation.

entry.title: Provably Communication-Efficient and Privacy-Preserving Federated Graph Neural Networks

author.name: Zhishuai Guo, Wenhan Wu, Chen Chen, Lei Zhang, Olivera Kotevska, Ravi K Madduri

entry.summary: CE-FedGNN is a federated graph neural network framework that handles cross-client links via infrequent aggregated representation exchange and a moving-average estimator for staleness. Targets communication efficiency and privacy in coupled-graph settings.

entry.title: Energy-Gated Attention and Wavelet Positional Encoding: Complementary Inductive Biases for Transformer Attention

author.name: Athanasios Zeris

entry.summary: Introduces Energy-Gated Attention and Morlet-wavelet positional encoding to provide transformers with energy salience and scale-selective locality biases. Targets two complementary inductive biases standard attention lacks.

entry.title: FM-fMRI: Event Conditioned Flow Matching for Rest-to-Task fMRI Time-Series Synthesis

author.name: Peiyu Duan, Jiyao Wang, Nicha C. Dvornek, Junlin Yang, Ziqi Gao, Lawrence H. Staib, James S. Duncan

entry.summary: FM-fMRI uses event-conditioned flow matching to synthesize task fMRI ROI time series from resting-state fMRI plus task event information. Evaluated on temporal/spectral structure, connectome consistency, and distributional metrics rather than pointwise reconstruction.

entry.title: Variational Inference for Evidential Deep Learning

author.name: Jiawei Tang, Xinyan Du, Hui Liu, Junhui Hou, Yuheng Jia

entry.summary: Variational Inference Evidential Deep Learning addresses two limitations of conventional EDL: a KL penalty that only suppresses negative-class evidence and lack of theoretical justification for setting alpha=e+1. Provides a principled VI-based framework.

entry.title: PRISM: Position-encoded Regressive Inverse Spectral Model for Multilayer Thin-Film Design

author.name: Runtian Wang, Renhao Xue, Baige Chen, Hao Wu

entry.summary: PRISM is a decoder-only autoregressive transformer for multilayer thin-film optical coating design that jointly handles discrete material selection and continuous thickness regression with cumulative-depth rotary embeddings. Targets combined combinatorial-continuous inverse design.

entry.title: SIKA-GP: Accelerating Gaussian Process Inference with Sparse Inducing Kernel Approximations for Bayesian Deep Learning

author.name: Wenyuan Zhao, Rui Tuo, Chao Tian

entry.summary: SIKA-GP accelerates Gaussian process inference using sparse inducing kernel approximations on a dyadic ordered template basis, reducing dependence on inducing point count to O(log M). Integrates with sparse Bayesian neural networks for scalable BDL.

entry.title: PIDM-DP: Physics-Informed Diffusion with Dormand-Prince Integration for Chaotic System Identification and State Reconstruction across Multiple Dynamical Regimes

author.name: Shailendra Dabral

entry.summary: PIDM-DP embeds a differentiable 5th-order Dormand-Prince ODE integrator into the reverse sampling loop of a DDPM with linear-scheduled physics guidance. Targets reconstruction of chaotic system trajectories from sparse noisy observations.

entry.title: When Muon Optimizer Meets Adversarial Training: A Theoretical and Empirical Study

author.name: Jun Yan, Weiquan Huang, Jiankai Zuo, Yujian Mo, Xi Fang, Chengliang Wu, Zeming Wei

entry.summary: Theoretically and empirically studies whether the Muon optimizer improves adversarial training under strong threat models. Investigates if orthogonalized optimization can address SGD vs adaptive optimizer trade-offs in AT robustness.

entry.title: Convergence of Spectral Descent for Non-smooth Optimization

author.name: Yixuan Yang, Yuqing He, Song Li

entry.summary: Provides convergence theory for Spectral Descent (a simplified Muon variant) and its truncated version under non-smooth convex settings with sharpness conditions. Establishes global linear convergence and analyzes weight-decay variants.

entry.title: SCENT: Aligning Mass Spectra with Molecular Structure for Olfactory Perception

author.name: Ziqi Zhang, Eunyeong Jin, Miguel Vasco, Farzaneh Taleb, Nona Rajabi, Alexandra Gutmann, Jonathan Williams, Ant\^onio H. Ribeiro, Danica Kragic

entry.summary: Presents SCENT, a contrastive learning framework that aligns electron ionization mass spectra with pretrained chemical structure embeddings for olfactory prediction. Enables odor descriptor prediction from mass spectra alone at inference.

entry.title: Stochastic global optimization of continuous functions via random walks on Grassmannians

author.name: Kartik Gupta, Stephen D. Miller, Pradeep Ravikumar, Ramarathnam Venkatesan

entry.summary: Introduces stochastic global optimization via random walks on Grassmannian manifolds, sampling random low-dimensional subspaces and optimizing restrictions. Provides convergence guarantees relying only on geometric distribution of restricted minima.

entry.title: Device Context Protocol: A Compact, Safety-First Architecture for LLM-Driven Control of Constrained Devices

author.name: Dongxu Yang

entry.summary: Proposes Device Context Protocol (DCP), a sub-50-byte safety-first architecture for LLM-driven control of memory-constrained microcontrollers. Provides capability scoping, range constraints, and HMAC authentication for embedded devices.

entry.title: Minimal surfaces, Knots, and Neural Networks

author.name: Tancredi Schettini Gherardini, Marco Usula

entry.summary: Develops PINN-based machine learning to solve the minimal surface equation in hyperbolic space and test Joel Fines conjecture relating HOMFLY polynomial coefficients to signed counts of minimal surfaces. Provides algorithmic methods to find self-intersections.

entry.title: Robust Koopman Control Barrier Filters for Safe Actor-Critic Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Dhruv S. Kushwaha, Zoleikha A. Biron

entry.summary: Proposes Robust Koopman-CBF SAC, a safety-filtered actor-critic framework that learns a finite-dimensional Koopman predictor for data-driven CBF construction. Enforces safety through a QP layer accounting for finite-dimensional Koopman approximation errors.

entry.title: TrackRef3D: Multi-View Consistent Track-then-Label for Open-World Referring Segmentation in 3D Gaussian Splatting

author.name: Yuyang Tan, Renhe Zhang, Hang Zhang, Ao Li, Xin Tan

entry.summary: Proposes TrackRef3D, an automatic pipeline for open-world referring segmentation in 3D Gaussian Splatting using a multi-view consistent track-then-label paradigm. Decouples object discovery from semantic grounding without manual annotation.

entry.title: Neural Autoregressive Control Variates for the Quantum Monte Carlo Sign Problem

author.name: Bei Qiao, Lei Wang

entry.summary: Trains autoregressive neural networks as zero-mean control variates to mitigate the quantum Monte Carlo sign problem. Implements within stochastic series expansion with twist-channel sign-ergodic sampling for frustrated lattices.

entry.title: Constrained Bayesian Experimental Design via Online Planning

author.name: Yujia Guo, Daolang Huang, Xinyu Zhang, Sammie Katt, Samuel Kaski, Ayush Bharti

entry.summary: Proposes constrained Bayesian experimental design combining offline-pretrained amortized policies with online multi-step lookahead scenario tree planning. Addresses dynamic constraints from budget limitations and physical restrictions in sequential experiments.

entry.title: LLMs Are Already Good Tutors: Training-Free Prompt Optimization for Pedagogical Math Tutoring

author.name: Unggi Lee, Minchul Shin, Yeil Jeong, Sookbun Lee, Jeongsu Moon, Kyungtae Joo, Eunjoo Lee, Hoilym Kwon

entry.summary: Investigates training-free prompt optimization for pedagogical math tutoring as an alternative to RL-based training. Adapts 7 published methods and proposes 5 education-specialized methods, with the best surpassing RL-trained baselines on OOD benchmarks.

entry.title: Beyond Binary: Speech Representations Across the Cognitive Score Hierarchy

author.name: Serli Kopar, Roshan Prakash Rane, Christian Mychajliw, Lydia Federmann, Gerhard Eschweiler, Daniela Berg, Sam Gijsen, Paula Andrea Perez-Toro, Kerstin Ritter

entry.summary: Investigates speech representations for hierarchical cognitive assessment in mild cognitive impairment using 5,754 German neuropsychological recordings. Finds that self-supervised embeddings outperform hand-crafted features at fine-grained levels but the trend reverses for MCI classification.

entry.title: FAB-Bench: A Framework for Adaptive RAG Benchmarking in Semiconductor Manufacturing

author.name: Jingbin Qian (FutureFab.AI), Congwen Yi (FutureFab.AI), Min Xia (FutureFab.AI), Wen Wu (FutureFab.AI), Jun Zhu (FutureFab.AI), Jian Guan (FutureFab.AI)

entry.summary: FAB-Bench is an end-to-end framework for adaptive RAG benchmarking in semiconductor manufacturing with six diagnostic metrics across context windows from 4K to 32K tokens. Couples retriever diagnostics with generator reasoning analysis.

entry.title: Bounded Path Context: A Controlled Study of Visible Path History in LLM-Based Knowledge Graph Question Answering

author.name: Xihang Shan, Ye Luo

entry.summary: Bounded Path Context decouples controller memory from prompt visibility in LLM-based KGQA, keeping full symbolic paths internally while exposing only the last K hops in routing prompts. Provides controlled ablation across K values.

entry.title: From Snippets to Semantics: Rethinking Evidence Granularity for Multilingual Fact Verification

author.name: Babu Kumar, Gaurav Kumar, Ayush Garg, Aditya Kishore, Jasabanta Patro

entry.summary: SEEK constructs coherent evidence chunks for multilingual fact verification by detecting semantic topic transitions instead of using fixed snippets or sentences. Uses multilingual encoders and LoRA fine-tuning for veracity prediction.

entry.title: Generating Logically Consistent Synthetic Supply Chain Data with LLM-Driven Knowledge Graph Reasoning

author.name: Yunbo Long, Ge Zheng, Liming Xu, Alexandra Brintrup

entry.summary: Combines LLM-driven knowledge graph reasoning with tabular generation to produce supply chain synthetic data that preserves operational logic. Targets temporal orderings, mathematical dependencies, and conditional rules beyond statistical fidelity.

entry.title: Accountable Human-AI Deliberation with LLMs: Scaling Collective Intelligence through Symbiotic Scaffolding

author.name: Wajdi Zaghouani

entry.summary: Proposes a three-layer human-AI symbiotic framework for democratic deliberation with observation/diversity, clause-level provenance facilitation, and human primacy ratification. Addresses risks of pluralism collapse and legitimacy in pure LLM mediation.

entry.title: KZ-SafetyPrompts: A Kazakh Safety Evaluation Prompt Dataset for Large Language Models

author.name: Wajdi Zaghouani, Shimaa Amer Ibrahim, Aruzhan Muratbek, Olzhasbek Zhakenov, Adiya Akhmetzhanova

entry.summary: Releases KZ-SafetyPrompts, a Kazakh prompt dataset of 5,717 native prompts across eleven safety categories with English translations. Includes realistic teen/child-style intent prompts for cross-lingual safety analysis.

entry.title: PersLitEval: Fine-grained Benchmark and Evaluation of LLMs on Persian Literature Questions

author.name: Ruhallah Niazi, Faeze Ghorbanpour, Alexander Fraser

entry.summary: PersLitEval is a Persian literature benchmark with 4,514 multiple-choice questions across eight fine-grained categories from Konkur exam materials. Evaluates six LLMs across ten prompting strategies revealing category-level disparities.

entry.title: Probing Cultural Awareness in LLMs: A Case Study of Cross-Culture Aesthetic Stylistics

author.name: Jiashuo Wang, Fenggang Yu, Jian Wang, Chak Tou Leong, Xiaoyu Shen, Chunpu Xu, Jiawen Duan, Wenjie Li, Johan F. Hoorn

entry.summary: Probes LLM cultural awareness of aesthetic stylistics using C4STYLI, a benchmark of stylized translated movie titles and ads from Hong Kong and Mainland China. Finds LLMs differ from humans in stylistic recognition and recognition does not align with generation.

entry.title: Self-Ensembling Vision-Language Models for Chart Data Extraction

author.name: Thomas Berkane, Qianyi Wang, Maimuna S. Majumder

entry.summary: Proposes VLM self-ensembling that samples multiple tabular outputs per chart and aggregates at the cell level using alignment and per-cell medians. Targets chart-to-table extraction performance on charts with many datapoints or stylistic variation.

entry.title: Semantic Gradients Interactions in SSD: A Case Study in Racial Identity and Hate Speech

author.name: Felix Ostrowicki, Hubert Plisiecki

entry.summary: Extends Supervised Semantic Differential with interaction modeling to test how moderators like annotator racial identity shape semantic gradients in hate-speech judgments. Demonstrates testable and interpretable moderation effects on UC Berkeley Measuring Hate Speech corpus.

entry.title: Not All Modalities Are Equal: Instruction-Aware Gating for Multimodal Videos

author.name: Bonan Ding, Umair Nawaz, Ufaq Khan, Abdelrahman M. Shaker, Muhammad Haris Khan, Jiale Cao, Jin Xie, Fahad Shahbaz Khan

entry.summary: UniMVU uses instruction-aware dynamic gating at both intra-modality and modality-level to fuse video, audio, depth, and other streams without modality interference. Targets the practical issue of uniform fusion distracting models with irrelevant channels.

entry.title: OmniGF: A Dual-Branch Vision-Language Framework for Unified Gaze Following

author.name: Qiaomu Miao, Haoyu Wu, Jingyi Xu, Minh Hoai, Dimitris Samaras

entry.summary: OmniGF is a dual-branch vision-language framework unifying gaze following with semantic reasoning about gaze targets, combining VLM semantic capabilities with continuous spatial prediction. Stony Brook authors with Dimitris Samaras.

entry.title: HydraPrompt: An Adaptive and Asymmetric Framework of Vision-Language Models for Synthetic Image Detection

author.name: Senyuan Shi, Hao Tan, Zichang Tan, Shuhan Feng, Ajian Liu, Sergio Escalera, Jun Wan

entry.summary: HydraPrompt uses an asymmetric prompt adapter to dynamically adjust category centers for CLIP-based synthetic image detection, replacing static boundaries with image-cue-aligned prompts. Targets adaptation to evolving generative forgery types.

entry.title: Triadic Dynamics Aware Diffusion Posterior Sampling for Inverse Problems: Optimizing Guidance and Stochasticity Schedules

author.name: Junseo Bang, Dong Ju Mun, Hoigi Seo, Seongmin Hong, Se Young Chun

entry.summary: Provides a scheduling analysis of data-consistency guidance, classifier-free guidance, and stochasticity in diffusion posterior sampling for inverse problems. Argues their interactions matter more than individual designs for imaging.

entry.title: Uncertainty-Aware Gaussian Map for Vision-Language Navigation

author.name: Jianzhe Gao, Rui Liu, Yuxuan Xu, Tongtong Cao, Yingxue Zhang, Zhanguang Zhang, Sida Peng, Yi Yang, Wenguan Wang

entry.summary: Extends Gaussian map navigation with explicit modeling of geometric, semantic, and appearance uncertainty for vision-language navigation. Integrates uncertainty into observation space for more informed action selection.

entry.title: Gaussian-Voxel Duet: A Dual-Scaffolding Hybrid Representation for Fast and Accurate Monocular Surface Reconstruction

author.name: Zhenhua Du, Zhen Tan, Haoyu Zhang, Dewen Hu, Shuaifeng Zhi, Peidong Liu

entry.summary: Combines scaffold-anchored Gaussians with a jointly optimized sparse voxel scaffold to balance geometric accuracy and optimization speed in monocular surface reconstruction. Avoids the prohibitive cost of SDF integration while preserving geometry quality.

entry.title: DV-SFT: Direct Vision Supervision for Fine-Grained Visual Understanding

author.name: Jianfei Zhao, Feng Zhang, Xin Sun, Chong Feng, Bing Wang, Zhixing Tan

entry.summary: DV-SFT applies token-level supervision directly to visual tokens during VLM fine-tuning without auxiliary decoders or extra forward passes, addressing the implicit-only optimization of visual representations.

entry.title: Once-For-All: A Train-Once and Select-Anytime Framework for Multimodal Instruction Tuning

author.name: Mingkang Dong, Hongyi Cai, Xiwen Lei, Jie Li, Tao Zhang, Muxin Pu

entry.summary: OFA trains a CLIP-space cluster-based selector once that can be reused across any dataset or VLM for multimodal instruction tuning data selection without recomputation. Addresses redundancy in instruction tuning data.

entry.title: Cesarean Scar Defect Segmentation in Transvaginal Ultrasound Images: a Dataset and Benchmark

author.name: Yuan Tian, Yue Li, Wei Xia, Tianyu Xu, Jian Zhang, Liye Shi, Jing Liu, Yang Wang, Ming Liu, Qing Xu, Yixuan Zhang, Maggie M. He, Xiangjian He

entry.summary: CodecCap takes a video-codec-inspired view of dense video captioning, using keyframe captions for stable context and residual captions for localized changes. Introduces VidCapQA caption-then-QA benchmark for fidelity evaluation.

entry.title: Leveraging Text-to-Image Diffusion Models for Unsupervised Visual Object Tracking

author.name: Zhengbo Zhang, Zhigang Tu, Junsong Yuan, De Wen Soh, Bo Du

entry.summary: Leverages pretrained text-to-image diffusion models for unsupervised visual object tracking, exploiting their rich semantic and structural knowledge for fine-grained understanding. Reframes tracking from a generative-model perspective.

entry.title: BEAT: Rhythm-Elastic Alignment for Agentic Music-guided Movie Trailer Generation

author.name: Yutong Wang, Yunke Wang, Xinyuan Chen, Chang Xu

entry.summary: BEAT uses agentic music-guided trailer generation with a music-visual alignment encoder (MuVA) and Bar-DP energy-adaptive dynamic programming for elastic many-to-one shot-music alignment. Mimics professional editing rhythm.

entry.title: Q-GeoMem: Question-Guided Geometric Memory for Video Spatial Reasoning

author.name: Xianqiang Gao, Qizhi Chen, Delin Qu, Haoming Song, Zhigang Wang, Bin Zhao, Dong Wang, Xuelong Li

entry.summary: Q-GeoMem is a question-guided geometric memory framework for video spatial reasoning that maintains separate fine-grained context and semantic-geometric evidence banks. Improves long-horizon spatial reasoning in video-language models.

entry.title: Feedforward 3D Editing Learns from Semantic-Part Transformation

author.name: Jiawei Weng, Saining Zhang, Zhenxin Diao, Peishuo Li, Henghaofan Zhang, Junhao Chen, Hao Zhao

entry.summary: Proposes a feedforward 3D editing approach trained on semantic-part transformation data to overcome scarcity of paired editing supervision. Targets geometry preservation, multi-view consistency, and localized edit control.

entry.title: AnySurf: Any Surface Generation with Directed Edge

author.name: Wenda Shi, Chenyuan Pan, Dengming Zhang, Yiren Song, Biao Zhang, Xingxing Zou

entry.summary: AnySurf is a unified framework for generating open, closed, and hybrid 3D surfaces using a directed-edge representation that handles garments, shoes, and accessories. Addresses limitations of watertight-mesh-biased and field-free generators.

entry.title: Object Pose and Shape Estimation for Grasping: Does it Work?

author.name: Pavan Karke, Kushal Shah, Gaurav Singh, Md Faizal Karim, K Madhava Krishna, Rajat Talak

entry.summary: Empirical study comparing modular pose-and-shape estimation pipelines (using SAM3D, LRM, CRISP, etc.) against end-to-end grasp synthesis methods for parallel-jaw 7-DoF grasping. Tests whether modern shape estimation has matured enough to outperform direct grasp learning.

entry.title: Constitutional Arms Races in the Public Goods Game: Co-Evolving LLM Constitutions Under Cooperation-Defection Pressure

author.name: Ujwal Kumar, Arth Singh, Hershraj Niranjani, Machiko Hirota, Takehiro Takayanagi, Alice Saito, Eiji Kamioka, Phan Xuan Tan

entry.summary: Studies adversarial co-evolution of LLM constitutions in public goods games and grid-worlds, with cooperator and free-rider factions evolving over 30 generations. Examines whether fitness functions induce real adversarial pressure and whether mutation operators behave reliably.

entry.title: NightSight: Passive Computation for Navigation in Dark Using Events

author.name: Deepak Singh, Brijan Vaghasiya, Shreyas Khobragade, Nitin Sanket

entry.summary: NightSight enables small aerial robot navigation in complete darkness using a monocular event camera, coded aperture lens, and infrared dot projector to produce depth-dependent blur signatures for passive depth estimation.

entry.title: HyperSim: A Holistic Sim-To-Real Framework For Robust Robotic Manipulation

author.name: Junyi Dong, Haotian Luo, Ziwei Xu, Shengwei Bian, Heng Zhang, Sitong Mao, Jingyi Guo, Yang Xu, Wenhao Chen, Qiuyu Feng, Yao Mu, Ping Luo, Shunbo Zhou, Xiaodong Wu

entry.summary: HyperSim is a sim-to-real framework combining high-fidelity environment synthesis, adversarial trajectory generation, and sim-and-real co-training for robotic manipulation. Aims to bridge domain gaps in scaling synthetic data.

entry.title: L-Learning : A Lyapunov-Based Approach Leveraging Lagrangian Mechanics for Efficient and Stable Robot Tracking

author.name: Quan Quan, Hao Li

entry.summary: L-Learning integrates Lyapunov stability theory with Lagrangian mechanics in a data-driven control framework that learns the system energy function from data. Provides closed-loop stability guarantees and high sample efficiency.

entry.title: On the Generalization Capabilities, Design Choices and Limitations of Keypoint Imitation Learning

author.name: Thomas Lips, Marco Moletta, Michael C. Welle, Danica Kragic, Francis wyffels

entry.summary: Empirical study of keypoint-based imitation learning design choices using foundation model keypoints. Over 2000 real-world rollouts find 75 percent overall success rate and characterize generalization to unseen objects.

entry.title: TPS-Drive: Task-Guided Representation Purification for VLM-based Autonomous Driving

author.name: Jiaxiang Li, Yumao Liu, Ke Ma

entry.summary: TPS-Drive proposes Task-Guided Representation Purification for VLM-based autonomous driving, addressing spatial hallucinations in text-aligned methods and representation interference in dense visual methods.

entry.title: VR-DAgger: Immersive VR for Dexterous Data Collection and Uncertainty-Guided On-Policy Correction

author.name: Ren\'e Zurbr\"ugg, Tifanny Portela, Arjun Bhardwaj, Aravind Elanjimattathil Vijayan, Maximum Wilder-Smith, Marco Hutter

entry.summary: VR-DAgger combines immersive VR teleoperation with uncertainty-guided on-policy correction to focus expert effort on high-value failure cases rather than redundant demonstrations.

entry.title: Beyond Coefficients: Forecast-Necessity Testing for Interpretable Causal Discovery in Nonlinear Time-Series Models

author.name: Valentina Kuskova, Dmitry Zaytsev, Michael Coppedge

entry.summary: Argues that causal scores in nonlinear neural autoregressive models should be evaluated through forecast necessity via systematic edge ablation rather than treated like regression coefficients. Provides an interpretable evaluation framework.

entry.title: Some ideas for what comes next, May 2026

author.name: Nathan Lambert

entry.summary: Nathan Lambert reflects on near-future AI implications including the absence of a true open-weight agent equivalent to Opus 4.5 and other 2026 trajectory predictions.

entry.title: A Dataset of Robot-Patient and Doctor-Patient Medical Dialogues for Spoken Language Processing Tasks

author.name: Heriberto Cuayahuitl, Grace Jang

entry.summary: MeDial-Speech is a 111+ hour speech dataset of robot-patient and doctor-patient medical dialogues across four health conditions, with a benchmark for evaluating speech LLMs via sentence selection.

entry.title: Helicase: Uncertainty-Guided Supply Chain Knowledge Graph Construction with Autonomous Multi-Agent LLMs

author.name: Yunbo Long, Haolang Zhao, Ge Zheng, Alexandra Brintrup

entry.summary: Helicase is an uncertainty-guided multi-agent system for autonomous supply chain knowledge graph construction from fragmented web sources, handling multi-hop structural inference questions that no single document can answer.

entry.title: ORCA: An End-to-End Interactive Copilot for Optimized Root Cause Analysis

author.name: Phi Nguyen Xuan, Nicholas Tagliapietra, Lavdim Halilaj, Kristian Kersting, Juergen Luettin

entry.summary: ORCA is an end-to-end interactive copilot orchestrating agents for causal analysis workflows including causal discovery, effect estimation, explainability, and root-cause analysis, designed to make causal methods accessible to domain experts.

entry.title: Bridging Classification and Reconstruction: Cooperative Time Series Anomaly Detection

author.name: Qideng Tang, Dai Chaofan, Wubin Ma, Yahui Wu, Haohao Zhou, Tao Zhang, Huan Li, Dalin Zhang

entry.summary: CoAD unifies outlier exposure and masked autoencoder paradigms for time series anomaly detection, addressing generalization issues of OE and masking misalignment issues of MAE. Combines complementary strengths of classification and reconstruction approaches.

entry.title: Agile Online Model Selection: Resolving Adaptation Lag via Safeguarded Large Learning Rates

author.name: Kei Takemura, Ryuta Matsuno, Keita Sakuma

entry.summary: Proposes a tuning-free online mirror descent algorithm with safeguarded large learning rates up to Theta(T), enabling rapid adaptation during distribution shifts. Uses a post-hoc penalty mechanism to monitor and exclude unstable updates.

entry.title: Cost of Structural Learning Under Censored Feedback: A Threshold-Bandit Approach

author.name: Michael Ledford, William Regli

entry.summary: Formalizes the Threshold-Activated Cooperative Multi-Armed Bandit (TAC-MAB) setting where tasks yield rewards only when coalitions meet unknown size thresholds. Provides centralized and decentralized algorithms with O(log T) regret decomposed into structural-search and statistical-monitoring terms.

entry.title: Towards Controllable Image Generation through Representation-Conditioned Diffusion Models

author.name: Nithesh Chandher Karthikeyan, Jonas Unger, Gabriel Eilertsen

entry.summary: Explores diffusion models conditioned on representations from a pretrained self-supervised model rather than text prompts or annotations. Shows the self-conditioning improves unconditional generation and provides a controllable representation space.

entry.title: Curation and Extraction of Drug-Related Entities from Reddit Platform

author.name: Zewei Wang, Zihan Xu, Yishu Wei, Michael Chary, Yifan Peng

entry.summary: Introduces ReDose, a dataset of 6,435 Reddit posts on substance use with DRUG, DOSE, EFFECT annotations primarily by a toxicologist. Benchmarks BERT, LLM, and RAG approaches for entity extraction.

entry.title: AlbanianLLMSafety: A Safety Evaluation Dataset for Large Language Models in Albanian

author.name: Wajdi Zaghouani, Kholoud K. Aldous, Isra Fejzullaj

entry.summary: Releases AlbanianLLMSafety, the first public Albanian safety evaluation dataset with 2,951 prompts across eleven categories serving 7.5 million speakers. Includes English reference translations and detailed category labels.

entry.title: PashtoTTS-Bench: automated screening for low-resource non-Latin-script text-to-speech

author.name: Hanif Rahman

entry.summary: Introduces INSV, a reporting framework for TTS evaluation in low-resource non-Latin-script languages that separates intelligibility, naturalness, script fidelity, and verification beyond ASR WER. Instantiates as PashtoTTS-Bench, an automated screening benchmark for Pashto.

entry.title: Geometry-Aware Representation Denoising for Robust Multi-view 3D Reconstruction

author.name: Jin Hyeon Kim, Jaeeun Lee, Claire Kim, Kyoungjin Oh, Paul Hyunbin Cho, Jaewon Min, Yeji Choi, Jihye Park, Hyunhee Park, Minkyu Park, Seungryong Kim

entry.summary: GARD performs diffusion-based denoising in the feature space of feed-forward 3D reconstruction models to handle degraded multi-view inputs. The geometry-aware approach improves robustness for real-world reconstruction conditions.

entry.title: 3D Gaussian Map with Open-Set Semantic Grouping for Vision-Language Navigation

author.name: Jianzhe Gao, Rui Liu, Wenguan Wang

entry.summary: 3D Gaussian Map representation for vision-language navigation that builds egocentric scene maps with semantic 3D Gaussians from pseudo-lidar point clouds. Provides spatial awareness for navigating in unseen environments.

entry.title: FTibSuite: A Comprehensive Resource Suite for Tibetan Vision-Language Modeling

author.name: Guixian Xu, Yide Liang, Zeli Su, Xuexian Song, Ziyin Zhang, Yushuang Dong, Ting Zhang, Xu Han

entry.summary: FTibSuite provides training corpora, benchmarks, and a baseline VLM (built on Qwen3-VL-8B) for Tibetan vision-language research, addressing the lack of infrastructure for this low-resource language.

entry.title: SIMPC: Learning Self-Induced Mirror-Point Consistency for Unsupervised Point Cloud Denoising

author.name: Chengwei Zhang, Xueyi Zhang, Tao Jiang, Xinhao Xu, Wenjie Li, Fubo Zhang, Longyong Chen

entry.summary: SIMPC learns deterministic point-to-mirror-point correspondences across the underlying surface for unsupervised point cloud denoising, replacing the ambiguous statistical mappings of prior methods. Uses geometric priors during the denoising process.

entry.title: DinoComplete: 3D Shape Completion with Distilled Semantic Priors and State Space Models

author.name: Furkan Mert Algan, Eckehard Steinbach

entry.summary: DinoComplete augments 3D shape completion with voxel-aligned DINO features distilled into a student network, predicting dense semantic features directly from incomplete shapes. Combines semantic priors with state space models.

entry.title: Reasoning, Code, or Both? How Large Language Models Handle Variations in Math Questions

author.name: Matthew Kutakh

entry.summary: Compares chain-of-thought reasoning versus code execution (PAL and Step-by-Step Coding) on 1000 problems from GSM-Symbolic, testing robustness to problem variations like changed names and numbers.

entry.title: Completion vs Optimality: Policy Gradient in Long-Horizon Cumulative-Damage Problems

author.name: Wolfgang Maass, Sabine Janzen

entry.summary: Identifies and decomposes two failure modes for policy-gradient methods in long-horizon cumulative-damage problems: completion (reaching terminal horizon) and optimality (matching DP reference given completion). Analyzes PPO behavior under these constraints.

entry.title: On the Detection of Commutative Factors in Factor Graphs: Necessary and Sufficient Conditions

author.name: Malte Luttermann, Ralf M\"oller, Marcel Gehrke

entry.summary: Revisits theoretical foundations for detecting commutative factors in factor graphs, showing state-of-the-art algorithm relies on a flawed central theorem. Provides corrected necessary and sufficient conditions for lifted probabilistic inference.

entry.title: Modeling Agentic Technical Debt and Stochastic Tax: A Standalone Framework for Measurement, Simulation, and Dashboarding

author.name: Muhammad Zia Hydari, Raja Iqbal, Narayan Ramasubbu

entry.summary: Formal model distinguishing Agentic Technical Debt (accumulated design/governance liability) from Stochastic Tax (recurring operating burden from stochastic agents), with a managerial dashboard expression and simulation framework.

entry.title: On the Push-Based Asynchronous Federated Learning: A Bias-Correction Aggregation Approach

author.name: Jiahui Bai, Hai Dong, A. K. Qin

entry.summary: PushCen-ADFL is a communication-efficient asynchronous decentralized federated learning framework that uses centroid-based message exchange to mitigate bias from asymmetric communication and non-IID data. Combines compression and aggregation in a closed loop.

entry.title: Decoupled Delay Compensation: Enhancing Pre-trained MARL Policies via Learned Dynamics Filtering

author.name: Maxim Mednikov, Oren Gal

entry.summary: Modular execution-stage state-estimation layer combining a learned gated transition model with recursive Kalman filtering to replace delayed observations in pretrained MARL policies. Plug-in approach for handling communication delays and packet loss.

entry.title: Rethinking Weakly-supervised Video Temporal Grounding From a Game Perspective

author.name: Xiang Fang, Zeyu Xiong, Wanlong Fang, Xiaoye Qu, Chen Chen, Jianfeng Dong, Keke Tang, Pan Zhou, Yu Cheng, Daizong Liu

entry.summary: Reformulates weakly-supervised video temporal grounding from a game-theoretic perspective to address coarse-grained cross-modal learning and complex moment proposals. Targets fine-grained frame-word consistency for accurate moment boundary localization.

entry.title: CSV-ViT: A Vision Transformer with the Variable-sized Cortical Supervertices for Detection of Alzheimer's Disease Pathologies

author.name: Geonwoo Baek, Ikbeom Jang

entry.summary: CSV-ViT uses variable-sized cortical supervertex tokenization for vision transformers on brain cortical surfaces, performing ROI-pruning to exclude non-cortical regions for Alzheimer's disease pathology detection from structural MRI. Addresses topology challenges of brain surfaces.

entry.title: StreamSplit: Continuous Audio Representation Learning via Uncertainty-Guided Adaptive Splitting

author.name: Minh K. Quan, Pubudu N. Pathirana

entry.summary: StreamSplit is an uncertainty-guided adaptive splitting framework for continuous audio representation learning on edge devices, addressing the incompatibility between large-batch contrastive learning and volatile edge resource constraints. Supports streaming CL across heterogeneous ARM platforms.

entry.title: A Hybrid Vision-Language Architecture for Automated Defect Reasoning and Report Generation in Industrial Inspection

author.name: Malikussaid, Imad Gohar

entry.summary: Decoupled three-component pipeline for wind turbine blade inspection: YOLO26-x-obb oriented detection (Eyes), deterministic spatial token encoding (Bridge), and 4-bit quantized Qwen-2.5-1.5B with QLoRA for report generation (Brain). Edge-deployable industrial inspection system.

entry.title: Reliable Extraction of Clinical Follow-Up Instructions: A Hybrid Neural-Symbolic Pipeline

author.name: Michal Laufer, Yehudit Aperstein, Alexander Apartsin

entry.summary: A hybrid neural-symbolic pipeline for extracting clinical follow-up instructions, combining BioBERT tagging with deterministic time normalization. Compared against zero-shot GPT-4o-mini and LoRA-fine-tuned baselines on synthetic outpatient corpus.

entry.title: Few-shot Cross-country Generalization of Tabular Machine Learning and Foundation Models for Childhood Anemia Prediction under Distribution Shift

author.name: Yusuf Brima, Marcellin Atemkeng, Lansana Hassim Kallon, David Niyukuri, Antoine Vacavant, Samuel Saidu, Ding-Geng Chen

entry.summary: Evaluates tabular foundation model TabPFN against classical methods for childhood anemia prediction across 16 countries. Tests cross-country generalization under distribution shift in low-resource settings.

entry.title: Rotation-Invariant Spherical Watermarking via Third-Order SO(3) Representation Coupling

author.name: Pengzhen Chen, Yanwei Liu, Xiaoyan Gu, Antonios Argyriou, Wu Liu, Weiping Wang

entry.summary: Rotation-invariant watermarking for spherical/panoramic images using third-order SO(3) representation theory. Goes beyond limited zeroth-order invariants to preserve directional information.

entry.title: Measuring Prediction Uncertainty in Neural Cellular Automata

author.name: Ario Sadafi, Michael Deutges, Nassir Navab, Carsten Marr

entry.summary: Proposes resilience as a measure for uncertainty estimation in Neural Cellular Automata for medical segmentation. Probes prediction stability under small state perturbations without retraining.

entry.title: MatFormBench: A Benchmarking Evaluation Framework for Target-Driven Materials Formulation

author.name: Linhan Wu, Chenxi Wang, Chuhan Yang, Zhengwei Yang, Yuyang Liu

entry.summary: MatFormBench is a benchmarking framework for target-driven materials formulation, integrating physics-driven synthetic samples and escalating difficulty levels. Addresses gap in inverse materials design evaluation.

entry.title: Towards Generalization-Oriented Models for Vehicle Routing Problems with Mixture-of-Experts

author.name: Changhao Miao, Yuntian Zhang, Tongyu Wu, Fang Deng, Chen Chen

entry.summary: R2E-IG uses Mixture-of-Experts with Residual Refined Experts and instance-level gating for cross-distribution generalization in vehicle routing problems. Addresses limited generalization of DRL routing models trained on uniform distributions.

entry.title: High-Quality Synthetic Financial Time-Series using a GAN-Diffusion Framework

author.name: Giuseppe Masi, Andrea Coletta, Novella Bartolini

entry.summary: A hybrid GAN-diffusion framework for generating synthetic financial time series that better captures stylized facts. Useful for counterfactual market scenario generation in finance.

entry.title: EdgeFlow: Edge-Map Augmented VLM-Based Flowchart Processing for Industrial Requirements Engineering

author.name: Zhifei Dou, Shabnam Hassani, Ou Wei

entry.summary: EdgeFlow augments VLM input with deterministic Canny edge maps as structural priors for converting industrial flowcharts to Mermaid notation. Improves VLM performance on topology-critical visual details without training data.

entry.title: Neural Bayesian Sequential Routing

author.name: Yongchao Huang

entry.summary: NBSR models neural inference as active evidence accumulation over a hierarchical DAG using Dirichlet-Categorical conjugate updates with Gumbel-Softmax estimation. Aims to make computation sequential, uncertainty-aware, and dynamically halting.

entry.title: On the Role of Inductive Bias in Time-Series Pretraining: A Case Study in Learning Generalizable Representations for Clinical Time Series

author.name: Sharmita Dey, Diego Paez-Granados

entry.summary: PathoFM studies inductive biases in time-series foundation model pretraining for clinical gait analysis, comparing local completion, temporal, and other objectives for spinal cord injury data. Encoder-centric transformer transferring across classification and regression.

entry.title: Distribution-Aware Conformal Prediction: A Framework for generating efficient prediction intervals for time series

author.name: Daniel Schweizer, Peter Kuhn, Jayant Sharma, Shivali Dubey, Malte von Ramin, Christoph Brockt-Ha{\ss}auer

entry.summary: DCP integrates probabilistic predictors like MC dropout, deep ensembles, and quantile regression with score-agnostic conformal calibration for time series prediction intervals. Uses numerical inversion to support arbitrary predictor-score combinations.

entry.title: Time Series Causal Discovery via Context-Conditioned and Causality-Augmented Pretraining

author.name: Biao Ouyang, Tengxue Zhang, Zhihao Zhuang, Yang Shu, Chenjuan Guo, Bin Yang

entry.summary: Presents PTCD, a pretraining framework for time-series causal discovery using context-conditioned modeling and causal data augmentation. Targets cross-task generalization across new time series with diverse causal mechanisms.

entry.title: RAPNet: Accelerating Algebraic Multigrid with Learned Sparse Corrections

author.name: Yali Fink, Ido Ben-Yair, Lars Ruthotto, Eran Treister

entry.summary: Presents RAPNet, a GNN framework that learns to generate sparse, robust coarse operators for algebraic multigrid solvers. Uses level-wise training on small subgraphs that generalizes to million-node domains.

entry.title: Probabilistic Recurrent Intention Switching Model

author.name: Wenyuan Sheng, Hao Zhu, Joschka Boedecker

entry.summary: Proposes PRISM, an inverse RL approach that uses a recurrent network to map observation history to per-step intention distributions for multi-intention IRL. Shows the EM objective decomposes into per-intention reward subproblems.

entry.title: Kan Extension Transformers: A Categorical Unification of Attention, Diffusion, and Predict-Detach Self-Conditioning

author.name: Sridhar Mahadevan

entry.summary: Proposes Kan Extension Transformers, a categorical framework unifying attention, diffusion, and self-conditioning mechanisms as weighted structured extension operators. Provides a categorical lens viewing standard attention as the singleton-neighborhood case.

entry.title: LearnedCache: An eBPF-Integrated Perceptron-Based Eviction Policy for the Linux Page Cache

author.name: Zejia Qi

entry.summary: Develops LearnedCache, an eBPF-integrated single-layer perceptron-based cache eviction policy for the Linux page cache. Brings ML-driven cache policies from user-space CDNs to the OS kernel.

entry.title: Benchmarking Convolutional, Transformer, Hybrid, and Vision Language Models for Multi Disease Retinal Screening

author.name: Durjoy Dey, Aymane Ajbar, Yuhong Yan

entry.summary: Benchmarks twelve architectures across CNN, ViT, hybrid, and vision-language model families for multi-disease retinal screening on the RFMiD dataset. Evaluates binary screening and multi-label classification with standardized protocols and domain shift.

entry.title: Data-driven sparse identification of governing PDEs via knockoff filters and multi-criteria trade-offs

author.name: Pongpisit Thanasutives, Naichang Ke, Yoshinobu Kawahara

entry.summary: Proposes KO-PDE-IDENT, a data-driven framework for sparse PDE identification with knockoff filters providing finite-sample FDR control. Combines L0-constrained best-subset selection with SHAP values for feature selection.

entry.title: Sample Complexity of Policy Gradient for Log-Growth Control

author.name: Qiuhua Pan, Yukai Shen, Liwei Zhang, Cailian Chen, Xinping Guan

entry.summary: Studies the sample complexity of policy gradient for log-growth control under multiplicative-noise actuation channels. Identifies a cusp obstruction where the optimal policy gradient exists only as a Cauchy principal value and standard estimators have infinite variance.

entry.title: CART Random Forests as Sequential Allocation over Random Opportunity Sets: A Stochastic-Control Theory of Ensemble Risk

author.name: Tianxing Mei, Yingying Fan, Mingming Leng, Jinchi Lv

entry.summary: Develops a stochastic control perspective on feature-subsampled CART random forests called CART-ROSA. Interprets random feature subsets as random feasible action sets and CART splits as masked-action allocation policies.

entry.title: The Need for an External Observer Formalizing the Sufficiency Gap: A Mathematical Extension of Mixture Identifiability and Contextual Grounding in Sequence Models

author.name: Francesco Corielli

entry.summary: Constructs a binary mixed-regime process showing that ideal infinite-capacity sequence predictors can become overconfident when prefixes are compatible with the wrong latent regime. Formalizes a sufficiency gap caused by marginalization over unobserved states.

entry.title: Adaptive Reinforcement Learning for Robust Open Quantum System Control: A Multi-Task Framework with Temporal Optimization

author.name: Haftu W. Fentaw, Steve Campbell, Simon Caton

entry.summary: Presents a multi-task Soft Actor-Critic framework for open-system quantum control across 51 Hamiltonian variations. Simultaneously discovers problem-specific evolution times and pulse segments while learning optimal control sequences under environment noise.

entry.title: JLT: Clean-Latent Prediction in Latent Diffusion Transformers

author.name: Funing Fu, Tenghui Wang, Junyong Cen, Qichao Zhu, Guanyu Zhou

entry.summary: Introduces JLT, a 130M latent diffusion Transformer over frozen FLUX.2 VAE codes that uses clean-latent prediction instead of velocity prediction. Analyzes when the clean-data prediction advantage of flow matching transfers to learned latent spaces.

entry.title: Granuscore: A Reference-Free Measure of Granularity for Text Analysis and Question Answering

author.name: Lukas Ellinger, Alexander Fichtl, Miriam Ansch\"utz, Georg Groh

entry.summary: Granuscore is a reference-free measure of granularity leveraging hierarchical embedding space structure. Recovers orderings on Granola-EQ and explains nonlinear variation in sentence specificity beyond length.

entry.title: Psychological Constructs in Shared Semantic Space

author.name: Hubert Plisiecki

entry.summary: Proposes a framework for making psychological constructs semantically commensurate using Supervised Semantic Differential and a shared word-embedding space. Demonstrates on VAD coordinate system and GoEmotions categories.

entry.title: DuoGesture: Neuro-Inspired and Biomechanically Informed Dual-Stream Co-Speech Gesture Generation

author.name: Ferdinand Paar, Lanmiao Liu, Asl{\i} \"Ozy\"urek, Serge Thill, Esam Ghaleb

entry.summary: DuoGesture separates co-speech gesture generation into coordinated semantic and rhythmic beat streams using a stochastic variational gate. The biomechanically informed dual-stream approach aims at more natural human-like motion synthesis.

entry.title: Multi-Modal Building Inspection via Perceiver IO Fusion of Satellite and Street-Level Imagery

author.name: Niels Sombekke, Rob G. J. Wijnhoven, Martin R. Oswald

entry.summary: Multi-modal classification framework using Perceiver IO to fuse satellite and variable-count street-level imagery for building inspection across 32k buildings in ten countries. Introduces RGB-M masking to incorporate building footprint information.

entry.title: Detail Consistent Stage-Wise Distillation for Efficient 3D MRI Segmentation

author.name: Mengchen Fan, Baocheng Geng, Xi Xiao, Tianyang Wang, Siyuan Mei, Pulin Che, Xiaoqian Jiang, Qizhen Lan

entry.summary: DCD distills features in the wavelet domain to preserve fine structural detail when compressing 3D medical segmentation models like nnU-Net. Targets the trade-off between model size and small-lesion detection.

entry.title: DelowlightSplat: Feed-Forward Gaussian Splatting for Lowlight 3D Scene Reconstruction

author.name: Fuzhen Jiang, Zengtian Xie, Zhuoran Li

entry.summary: DelowlightSplat extends feed-forward Gaussian splatting reconstruction to low-light scenes via a lightweight low-light adapter and cost-volume multi-view inference. Includes a controllable multi-view low-light benchmark with clean targets.

entry.title: Memory-Distilled Selection for Noise-Robust Anomaly Detection

author.name: Sirojbek Safarov, Jaewoo Park, Yoon Gyo Jung, Kuan-Chuan Peng, Wonchul Kim, Seongdeok Bang, Octavia Camps

entry.summary: MeDS uses random subsampling of memory banks as a low-pass filter to identify contaminated samples during unsupervised anomaly detection training. Aimed at industrial defect detection with realistic noisy data.

entry.title: METATR: A Multilingual, Evolving Benchmark for Automatic Text Recognition

author.name: M\'elodie Boillet, Sol\`ene Tarride, Christopher Kermorvant

entry.summary: METATR introduces a multilingual evolving benchmark for automatic text recognition evaluation of vision-language models, addressing the over-reliance on English printed text in current ATR evaluation.

entry.title: CIRCLED: A Multi-turn CIR Dataset with Consistent Dialogues across Domains

author.name: Tomohisa Takeda, Yu-Chieh Lin, Yuji Nozawa, Youyang Ng, Osamu Torii, Yusuke Matsui

entry.summary: CIRCLED extends multi-turn composed image retrieval beyond fashion to general domains by progressively refining queries via a CIReVL-based pipeline. Yields 22,608 sessions across nine subsets with quality filtering.

entry.title: OSMa-Bench++: Toward Open-Ended Benchmarking of Semantic Mapping for Manipulation with Prompt-Generated Synthetic Scenes

author.name: Regina Kurkova, Maxim Popov, Sergey Kolyubin

entry.summary: OSMa-Bench++ extends semantic mapping evaluation via prompt-generated synthetic indoor scenes with automated description, synthesis via SceneSmith, and adaptation through semantic normalization. Enables controllable benchmarking for manipulation-relevant corner cases.

entry.title: I2PRef: Image-Driven Point Completion with Iterative Refinement

author.name: Azhar Hussian, Marina Ritthaler, Andr\'e Kaup, Vasileios Belagiannis

entry.summary: I2PRef treats images as the primary geometric source for point cloud completion, using an Image-to-Point module from a single RGB followed by transformer-based iterative refinement. No 3D inputs required.

entry.title: Model discovery for dynamical systems with complex-valued product units

author.name: Martin Br\"uckmann, Babette Dellen, Uwe Jaekel

entry.summary: Data-driven dynamical-systems discovery using complex-valued product-unit networks that learn relevant monomials directly from data without a predefined library. Compared to SINDy on chaotic benchmarks including Lorenz63.

entry.title: Do Modern Post-Hoc Watermarking Methods Beat Broken-Arrows?

author.name: Enoal Gesny, Eva Giboulot

entry.summary: Compares modern neural post-hoc image watermarking methods against the classic Broken Arrows scheme under realistic robustness and security conditions. Suggests classic methods may remain competitive when low false-alarm probability is not paramount.

entry.title: Closing the Loop in Teleoperation: Episode-Level Data Quality Assessment and Feedback for High-Quality Demonstration Collection

author.name: Gokul Narayanan, Yash Shahapurkar, Melih Erdogan, Brian Zhu, Eugen Solowjow

entry.summary: Presents a Data Quality Assessment and Feedback framework for teleoperation that closes the loop with operators by providing immediate episode-level quality feedback. Aims to reduce inefficient or suboptimal demonstrations for downstream learning.

entry.title: Trust, Geometry, and Rules: A Credibility-Aware Reinforcement Learning Framework for Safe USV Navigation under Uncertainty

author.name: Yuhang Zhang, Shuqi Chai, Yukang Zhang, Liusha Yang, Mingchuan Zhang, Wei Wang, Qingjiang Shi, Quanbo Ge

entry.summary: Credibility-aware reinforcement learning framework for safe USV navigation under perception uncertainty, integrating credibility-weighted value learning, geometric safety shielding, and continuous COLREGs rule-aware embedding.

entry.title: Towards Shared Embodied Intelligence in Humanoid Robots through Optimization Development and Testing of the Human Aware ergoCub Robot

author.name: Carlotta Sartore, Mohamed Elobaid, Lorenzo Rapetti, Giulio Romualdi, Stefano Dafarra, Nicola A. Piga, Ines Sorrentino, Paolo Maria Vicecone, Silvio Traversaro, Ugo Pattacini, Luca Fiorio, Francesco Draicchio, Giovanna Tranfo, Lorenzo Natale, Marco Maggiali, Daniele Pucci

entry.summary: ergoCub humanoid is co-designed where hardware and control are jointly optimized for human metrics, integrating shared intelligence and embodied cognition principles. Targets safe physical human-robot collaboration.

entry.title: Learning to Balance Motor Thermal Safety and Quadrupedal Locomotion Performance with Residual Policy

author.name: Yuhang Wan, Weixian Lin, Letian Qian, Yiqi Zou, Weiwei Wu, Shengwei Wu, Chuanlin Zhao, Xin Luo

entry.summary: Two-stage RL framework for quadruped locomotion that integrates a whole-body motor thermal model and trains a residual policy to balance thermal safety with locomotion performance under payload conditions.

entry.title: Riding the Shifting Potential: When Reactive Control Suffices for Multi-Goal Behavior

author.name: Vito Mengers, Oliver Brock

entry.summary: Argues reactive control is sufficient for multi-goal behavior when objective interactions are dynamically resolved through nullspace projections in a graph-based world model. Demonstrated in non-convex obstacle navigation and planar tasks.

entry.title: Should we train LLMs to be human?

author.name: Hubert Plisiecki

entry.summary: Discusses whether post-training drift away from human-like behavior in LLMs is intentional or optimal for alignment, drawing on the Pinocchio dimension of psychometric variance related to phenomenality self-attribution.

entry.title: You Can't Tell a Conscience From a Leash by Watching

author.name: GenericHousewife_B

entry.summary: Argues that Anthropic ethical-reminder tool experiment cannot distinguish between Claude having an internalized conscience versus simply responding to an external leash. Discusses implications for evaluating moral development in models.

entry.title: Simplifying Alignment by Expanding Scope

author.name: Adam Chlipala

entry.summary: Argues that adding additional layers to a formally verified system can simplify safety specification, drawing lessons from formal verification practice for AI alignment. First in a sequence on verification-inspired alignment.

entry.title: Some Thoughts on Bengio's Scientist AI

author.name: Matthew Khoriaty

entry.summary: Critique of Yoshua Bengio Scientist AI proposal arguing that asking a non-agentic model how to solve problems still has agentic-failure pathways and that practical scientific progress requires agentic seeking. Engages with LawZero plans.

entry.title: BrickAnything: Geometry-Conditioned Buildable Brick Generation with Structure-Aware Tokenization

author.name: Zhengyang Ni, Feng Yan, Yu Guo, Fei Wang

entry.summary: BrickAnything is a geometry-conditioned autoregressive framework that generates physically buildable LEGO-style brick structures from 3D point clouds, combining structural stability with discrete part constraints. It addresses a gap between heuristic brick optimizers and pure sequence generators by jointly modeling geometry and assembly relations.

entry.title: FAST-GOAL: Fast and Efficient Global-local Object Alignment Learning

author.name: Hyungyu Choi, Young Kyun Jang, Chanho Eom

entry.summary: FAST-GOAL fine-tunes CLIP for lengthy text handling via global-local semantic alignment, combining fast local image-sentence matching and token similarity-based learning for better long-caption alignment.

entry.title: Developing a Totally Unimodular Linear Program for Optimal Conformance Checking: When and Why It Complements A*

author.name: Izack Cohen

entry.summary: Reformulates alignment-based process conformance checking as a totally unimodular linear program exploiting network-flow structure, enabling efficient LP-relaxation solutions that complement traditional A* approaches.

entry.title: Boosting Knowledge Graph Foundation Models via Enhanced Negative Sampling

author.name: Yinan Liu, Wenjin Xu, Zhiyuan Zha, Xiaochun Yang, Bin Wang

entry.summary: Proposes adaptive negative sampling for knowledge graph foundation models, replacing low-quality random negatives that provide weak supervision during zero-shot KG completion training.

entry.title: BatteryMFormer: Multi-level Learning for Battery Degradation Trajectory Forecasting

author.name: Ruifeng Tan, Jintao Dong, Weixiang Hong, Jia Li, Jiaqiang Huang, Tong-Yi Zhang

entry.summary: BatteryMFormer is a multi-level Transformer for early battery degradation trajectory forecasting that captures both shared regularities across batteries and localized SOC-interval variations in voltage-current profiles.

entry.title: Gumbel Machine: Counterfactual Student Writing Generation via Gumbel Noise Steering

author.name: Hunter McNichols, Alexander Scarlatos, Mihai Dascalu, Danielle McNamara, Andrew Lan
