entry.summary: PathCal calibrates reflection markers ('wait', 'but', 'alternatively') in long CoT trajectories by distinguishing their distinct functional roles. Improves test-time reasoning control and efficiency.

entry.title: GEMQ: Global Expert-Level Mixed-Precision Quantization for MoE LLMs

author.name: Jianing Deng, Song Wang, Dongwei Wang, Zijie Liu, Tianlong Chen, Huanrui Yang, Jingtong Hu

entry.summary: GEMQ: Global Expert-level Mixed-precision Quantization for MoE LLMs using global linear programming for bit allocation and router fine-tuning. Addresses limitations of layer-wise importance estimation.

entry.title: Security of LLM-generated Code: A Comparative Analysis

author.name: Srivathsan G Morkonda, Mahmoud Selim, Hala Assal

entry.summary: Empirical security evaluation of code from 7 popular LLMs showing all generate code with vulnerabilities, building on prior developer-mimicking methodology. Documents real risks in LLM code generation.

entry.title: UfM*: Uncertainty from Motion* for DNN Depth Estimation Using Gaussians

author.name: Soumya Sudhakar, Sertac Karaman, Vivienne Sze

entry.summary: Proposes UfM*, a single-inference uncertainty estimation method for monocular depth DNNs using Gaussian mixtures to capture multiview disagreement. Efficient alternative to ensembles for safety-critical robotics.

entry.title: Operationalizing Individual Fairness via Gradient Descent and Bradley-Terry Models

author.name: Conlan Olson, Linjun Zhang, Zhun Deng, Pragya Sur

entry.summary: Algorithm for learning Mahalanobis similarity metrics for individual fairness from triplet queries via Bradley-Terry with spectral init plus gradient descent, with theoretical guarantees.

entry.title: Generative AI and the Reorganization of Labor Demand

author.name: Fangyan Wang, Zaiyan Wei, Yang Wang

entry.summary: Large-scale labor-economics study using LLM pipeline on US job postings to decompose generative AI exposure changes into between-firm and within-job-content margins.

entry.title: Composing People Together: Iterative Pose-Image Generation for Multi-Person Interaction Scenes

author.name: Wenxuan Peng, Bharath Hariharan, Hadar Averbuch-Elor

entry.summary: Dual pose-image diffusion model for multi-person interaction generation, jointly predicting 2D pose and RGB to improve compositional accuracy. Cornell/Hariharan group.

entry.title: IntentionNav: A Benchmark for Intent-Driven Object Navigation from Implicit Human Instruction

author.name: Lin Qian, Shijie Li, Sihao Lin, Xuan Zhang, Bangya Liu, Yanran Li, and Hujun Yin

entry.summary: IntentionNav: 500-intent benchmark with 4 controlled rewrites per intent for intent-driven object navigation from implicit instructions like 'I need to warm food.' 176 Isaac Sim scenes.

entry.title: Hidden Human-Like Nature of Machine-Generated Texts: Theory and Detection Enhancement

author.name: Chenwang Wu, Yiu-ming Cheung, Bo Han, Defu Lian

entry.summary: Reveals that even fully machine-generated text contains human-like spans that increase detection difficulty; proposes detection enhancement using this insight.

entry.title: CaST-Bench: Benchmarking Causal Chain-Grounded Spatio-Temporal Reasoning for Video Question Answering

author.name: Mingfang Zhang, Jingjing Pan, Ashutosh Kumar, Rajat Saini, Mustafa Erdogan, Hsuan-Kung Yang, Caixin Kang, Yifei Huang, Yoichi Sato, Quan Kong

entry.summary: CaST-Bench: 2,066 questions over 1,015 videos with bounding-box and temporal-segment annotations of causal chains for grounded spatio-temporal video reasoning evaluation.

entry.title: Entropy Equivalence Testing

author.name: Cl\'ement L. Canonne, Yash Pote, Jonathan Scarlett, Joy Qiping Yang

entry.summary: Introduces entropy equivalence testing (distinguish p=q vs |H(p)-H(q)|≥ε) with sample-efficient algorithm and application to closeness testing of Bayesian networks.

entry.title: GENSTRAT: Toward a Science of Strategic Reasoning in Large Language Models

author.name: Vartan Shadarevian, Kia Ghods, Alex Kenich, Anany Kotawala

entry.summary: GENSTRAT: procedurally generated two-player zero-sum imperfect-info card games for evergreen evaluation of strategic reasoning in LLM agents, resistant to contamination and saturation.

entry.title: Convex Optimization for Alignment and Preference Learning on a Single GPU

author.name: Miria Feng, Mert Pilanci

entry.summary: COALA: convex reformulation of preference optimization eliminating reference model and reducing GPU memory, with theoretical guarantees on a single GPU. Pilanci group.

entry.title: A Simple Plug-in for Improving Eviction-Based KV Cache Compression

author.name: Yuping Lin, Jiayuan Ding, Yue Xing, Pengfei He, Jiliang Tang, Subhabrata Mukherjee

entry.summary: VECTOR augments KV cache eviction with three-way routing (retain/approximate/evict) using reconstructability signals, recovering value information that binary eviction would lose. Useful for long-context LLM inference.

entry.title: Design and Report Benchmarks for Knowledge Work

author.name: Yining Hua, Hongbin Na, Cyrus Ayubcha, Levi Lian

entry.summary: Proposes a three-step approach (define work activity, specify setting, score work product) for designing knowledge-work AI benchmarks that better reflect real deployment. Critiques current benchmark practices.

entry.title: ChainFlow-VLA: Causal Flow Planning with Vision-Language Models

author.name: Xiyang Wang, Xinlin Wang, Tingguang Zhou, Gong Chen, Xingtai Gui, Zhi Xu, Xiaolei Wu, Feiyang Tan, Hangning Zhou, and Mu Yang

entry.summary: ChainFlow-VLA unifies causal autoregressive reasoning with diffusion-based global trajectory optimization for autonomous driving, addressing the AR vs diffusion dichotomy in trajectory generation.

entry.title: LangFlash: Feed-forward 3D Language Gaussian Splatting from Sparse Unposed Images

author.name: Yilong Liu, Wanhua Li, Chen Zhu-Tian, Hanspeter Pfister

entry.summary: LangFlash is a feed-forward 3D Language Gaussian Splatting framework for sparse unposed images, predicting geometry and language-aligned semantics in single forward pass. Authors from Harvard (Pfister).

entry.title: Parallel Context Compaction for Long-Horizon LLM Agent Serving

author.name: Musa Cim, Burak Topcu, Chita Das, Mahmut Taylan Kandemir

entry.summary: Parallel context compaction for long-horizon LLM agents addresses the blocking nature of summarization-based context management. Characterized across multiple backbones.

entry.title: Contrastive Distribution Matching for Amortized Sequential Monte Carlo in Discrete Diffusion

author.name: Jaihoon Kim, Taehoon Yoon, Prin Phunyaphibarn, Seungjun Kim, Morteza Mardani, Minhyuk Sung

entry.summary: Contrastive Distribution Matching amortizes Twisted SMC inference for discrete diffusion models by learning parameterized twist functions. Authors include Morteza Mardani (NVIDIA).

entry.title: Score-Based One-step MeanFlow Policy Optimization

author.name: Kyungyoon Kim, Donghyeon Ki, Hee-Jun Ahn, Byung-Jun Lee

entry.summary: Score-Based One-step MeanFlow Policy Optimization (SOM) constructs target velocity field from Q-function via score estimation, enabling one-step diffusion-style policies in online RL without target samples.

entry.title: From Correctness to Preference: A Framework for Personalized Agentic Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Ranxu zhang, zeyang li, Jiacheng Huang, Rui Zhang, Xiaozhou Xu, sun zhe, Yanyong Zhang and Chao Wang

entry.summary: PARPO: Personalized Anchor Reward-Decoupled Policy Optimization for agentic RL with user-conditioned behaviors, decoupling task-quality from preference rewards.

entry.title: Coupling-Robust Accuracy in Multiphysics Physics Informed Neural Networks via Kronecker-Preconditioned Optimization

author.name: Youngjae Park, Jaemin Kim, Junghwa Hong

entry.summary: NTK-based theoretical analysis of PINNs in coupled multiphysics systems, showing standard NTK spectral radius grows as Ω(γ²) with coupling but block-diagonal Gauss-Newton preconditioning bounds it independent of γ.

entry.title: When Planning Fails Despite Correct Execution: On Epistemic Calibration for LLM-Based Multi-Agent Systems

author.name: Zehao Wang, Shilong Jin, Zhao Cao, Lanjun Wang

entry.summary: EPC-AW addresses 'epistemic miscalibration' in LLM multi-agent planning where agents misjudge their knowledge despite correct execution. Assesses plan support under varying information.

entry.title: DFSAttn: Dynamic Fine-grained Sparse Attention for Efficient Video Generation

author.name: Jie Hu, Zixiang Gao, Yutong He, Kun Yuan

entry.summary: DFSAttn proposes dynamic fine-grained sparse attention for video diffusion transformers based on theoretical lower bound on attention recall, addressing block-sparse degradation at high sparsity.

entry.title: Semantically Structured Mixture-of-Experts for Compositional Robotic Manipulation

author.name: Chengyu Deng, Guanqi Chen, Yizhou Chen, Zejia Liu, Zhiwen Ruan, Guanhua Chen, Jia Pan

entry.summary: SMoDP routes mixture-of-experts based on semantic structure rather than low-level noise statistics for compositional robotic manipulation. Aims to align expert specialization with reusable behaviors.

entry.title: B-GRTO: Bootstrapped Group Relative Tool Optimization for Referring Segmentation

author.name: Mario Markov, Stefan Maria Ailuro, Mohammad Mahdi, Luc Van Gool, Danda Pani Paudel (INSAIT, Sofia University "St. Kliment Ohridski")

entry.summary: B-GRTO integrates trainable tools like segmentation decoders into reinforcement learning for vision-language systems via group relative tool optimization. Addresses principled integration of differentiable tools with RL.

entry.title: DrawVideo: Generating Long Video from Storyboard Keyframe Sketches

author.name: Chuanzhi Xu, Huiqi Liang, Bang Shi, Huiming Zhang, Yifan Xiao, Guangcheng Lin, Haodong Chen, Qiang Qu, Zhicheng Lu, Weidong Cai

entry.summary: DrawVideo enables sketch-guided storyboard-driven long video generation with shot-level control via sketches, appearance prompts, and motion prompts. Addresses controllability gap in long video synthesis.

entry.title: Learning partially observed systems with neural Hamiltonian ordinary differential equations

author.name: Sunniva Meltzer, S{\o}lve Eidnes, Alexander Johannes Stasik

entry.summary: NHODE combines Hamiltonian neural networks with neural ODEs for partially observed dynamical systems, enforcing energy conservation while inferring unobserved state variables. Extends physics-informed learning to partial observation regimes.

entry.title: PathNavigate: A Training-Free Pathology Agent with Surprise-Guided Scan and Shared Slide Memory for Whole-Slide Image VQA

author.name: Chunze Yang, Qidong Liu, Wenjie Zhao, Yue Tang, Jiusong Ge, Di Zhang, Jiashuai Liu, Lei Wu, Junbo Lu, Ni Zhang, Xian Wu, Zeyu Gao, Chen Li

entry.summary: PathNavigate is a training-free pathology agent for whole-slide VQA using surprise-guided scanning and shared slide memory to handle gigapixel slides. Avoids retraining costs of supervised pathology MLLMs.

entry.title: ARMS: Automatic Reward Shaping for Sparse-Reward Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Elie Abboud, Oren Gal

entry.summary: ARMS is a self-supervised reward shaping framework for sparse-reward MARL using trajectory ranking, with conditional best-response reasoning to preserve policy invariance. Addresses key bottleneck in MARL.

entry.title: Co-ReAct: Rubrics as Step-Level Collaborators for ReAct Agents

author.name: Jiazheng Kang, Bowen Zhang, Zixin Song, Jiangwang Chen, Xiao Yang, Da Zhu, Guanjun Jiang

entry.summary: Co-ReAct uses rubrics as step-level guidance during inference for ReAct agents, contrasting with prior evaluative-only uses. Practical agent action-selection framework.

entry.title: Adversarial Vulnerability Under Temporal Concept Drift: A Longitudinal Study of Android Malware Detection

author.name: Ahmed Sabbah, Mohammed Kharma, Radi Jarrar, Samer Zein, David Mohaisen

entry.summary: Decade-long longitudinal study of adversarial robustness for Android malware detection under temporal concept drift, with new metrics for adversarial-temporal coupling. Substantial empirical scope.

entry.title: Valid and Expressive Copulas for Irregular Multivariate Time Series

author.name: Christian Kl\"otergens, Tom Hanika, Lars Schmidt-Thieme, Vijaya Krishna Yalavarthi

entry.summary: CopFITi combines normalizing flows for marginals with Gaussian Mixture Copula for joint dependencies in irregular multivariate time series, marginalization-consistent by construction. Establishes new SOTA in IMTS density modeling.

entry.title: DualMem: Bypassing the Objectness Bottleneck for Calibrated Unknown-Stream Filtering in Open-World Object Detection

author.name: Yingjun Xiao (a), Xi Chen (b), Gang Fang (c), Siyuan Chen (b) ((a) School of Artificial Intelligence, Guangzhou University, Guangzhou, China, (b) School of Computer Science and Cyber Engineering, Guangzhou University, Guangzhou, China, (c) Institute of Computing Science and Technology, Guangzhou University, Guangzhou, China)

entry.summary: DualMem identifies an objectness-head information bottleneck in OWOD detectors, where decoder features have AUROC 0.908 but final scalar drops to 0.642. Addresses unknown-stream pollution in open-world detection.

entry.title: CVSearch: Empowering Multimodal LLMs with Cognitive Visual Search for High-Resolution Image Perception

author.name: Liupeng Li, Haoqian Kang, Zhenyu Lu, Jinpeng Wang, Bin Chen, Ke Chen, Yaowei Wang

entry.summary: CVSearch is a training-free adaptive framework dynamically scheduling expert-assisted vs scan-based visual search for high-resolution image perception with MLLMs. Addresses coverage-efficiency trade-off.

entry.title: Recursive Block-Diagonal Coupling for Resource-Efficient Training of Vision Models

author.name: Maxim Henry and Adrien Deli\`ege and S\'ebastien Pi\'erard and Marc Van Droogenbroeck

entry.summary: RBDC builds wide vision models by recursively coupling independently trained narrower models in a parameter-free block-diagonal fashion, achieving 30% FLOPs reduction on ImageNet with DeiT/ResNet. Practical training efficiency contribution.

entry.title: OpenSkillEval: Automatically Auditing the Open Skill Ecosystem for LLM Agents

author.name: Jiahao Ying, Boxian Ai, Wei Tang, Siyuan Liu, Yixin Cao

entry.summary: OpenSkillEval automatically evaluates skill-augmented agent systems and skill quality using dynamically constructed task instances from real-world artifacts. Addresses gaps in static benchmarks for the growing skill ecosystem.

entry.title: RiGS: Rigid-aware 4D Gaussian Splatting from a Single Monocular Video

author.name: Chenyu Wu, Wanhua Li, Zhu-Tian Chen, Hanspeter Pfister

entry.summary: RiGS introduces three Gaussian primitive types (static, rigid, transient) for monocular video reconstruction across multiple temporal scales, with object-wise dynamic mask aggregation. Addresses long-term smooth vs short-term complex motion trade-off.

entry.title: Operator Learning for Reconstructing Flow Fields from Sparse Measurements: a Language Model Approach

author.name: Qian Zhang and George Em Karniadakis

entry.summary: Reformulates flow-field reconstruction from sparse measurements as a sequence-to-sequence task using language model architectures, evaluated on vortex streets, climate, and other datasets. Co-authored by George Karniadakis (prominent in scientific ML).

entry.title: Any2Any: Efficient Cross-Embodiment Transfer for Humanoid Whole-Body Tracking

author.name: Ming Yang, Tao Yu, Feng Li, Hua Chen

entry.summary: Any2Any efficiently transfers pretrained whole-body tracking models across humanoid embodiments via kinematic alignment plus minimal data adaptation. Reduces the cost of deploying motion imitation policies on new humanoids.

entry.title: Hierarchical Concept Geometry in Language Models Emerges from Word Co-occurrence

author.name: Andres Nava and Matthieu Wyart

entry.summary: Provides a distributional theory showing that hypernymy hierarchies emerge in word embeddings due to word co-occurrence patterns, with leading eigenvectors progressively separating taxonomic branches. Theoretical insight into embedding geometry.

entry.title: Learning a Particle Dynamics Model with Real-world Videos

author.name: Chanho Kim, Suhas V. Sumukh, Li Fuxin

entry.summary: Trains particle-based physics dynamics models from real-world videos by leveraging recent point tracking methods to extract pseudo-state information, bridging the sim-to-real gap for world models.

entry.title: LaMo: Self-Supervised Latent Motion Priors for Physical Realism in Video Generation

author.name: Bo Jiang, Depu Meng, Yihan Hu, Yichen Xie, Tianshuo Xu, Wei Zhan

entry.summary: LaMo extracts self-supervised motion priors from unlabeled training videos for video diffusion, using Motion Drift Loss in training and Motion Prior Guidance at sampling time. Improves physical/motion consistency without external simulators or teachers.

entry.title: Multilingual Knowledge Transfer under Data Constraints via Lexical Interventions

author.name: Anastasiia Sedova, Natalie Schluter, Skyler Seto, Maartje ter Hoeve

entry.summary: LINK improves multilingual knowledge transfer during pretraining via lexical substitutions in high-resource data, without requiring parallel corpora or auxiliary models. Authors from Apple.

entry.title: Good Token Hunting: A Hitchhiker's Guide to Token Selection for Visual Geometry Transformers

author.name: Shuhong Zheng, Michael Oechsle, Erik Sandstr\"om, Marie-Julie Rakotosaona, Federico Tombari, Igor Gilitschenski

entry.summary: Two-stage token selection (inter-frame + intra-frame) for visual geometry transformers, restricting key/value tokens during global attention to address quadratic scaling. Authors from Google.

entry.title: SPACENUM: Revisiting Spatial Numerical Understanding in VLMs

author.name: Jianshu Zhang, Yijiang Li, Huifeixin Chen, Haoran Lu, Letian Xue, Bingyang Wang, Han Liu

entry.summary: SpaceNum benchmark systematically evaluates whether VLM numerical outputs (action magnitudes, coordinates) are genuinely grounded in spatial perception via bidirectional Num2Space and Space2Num tasks. Reveals weaknesses in current VLMs for embodied applications.

entry.title: From Raw Experience to Skill Consumption: A Systematic Study of Model-Generated Agent Skills

author.name: Zisu Huang, Jingwen Xu, Yifan Yang, Ziyang Gong, Qihao Yang, Muzhao Tian, Xiaohua Wang, Changze Lv, Xuemei Gao, Qi Dai, Bei Liu, Kai Qiu, Xue Yang, Dongdong Chen, Xiaoqing Zheng, Chong Luo

entry.summary: Systematic study of the full lifecycle of model-generated agent skills (experience generation, extraction, consumption) with a utility-grounded evaluation framework. Asks when and why such skills succeed or fail.

entry.title: Geo-Align: Video Generation Alignment via Metric Geometry Reward

author.name: Zizun Li, Haoyu Guo, Runzhe Teng, Chunhua Shen, Tong He

entry.summary: Geo-Align is the first RL framework for camera-controlled video re-rendering, using metric geometry rewards to improve adherence to physical scales and camera trajectories on out-of-distribution real-world videos.

entry.title: A (Slightly) Mechanistic Theory for Exponentially Increasing AI Time Horizons?

author.name: Oliver Sourbut

entry.summary: Thoughtful LessWrong analysis suggesting the METR AI 'time horizons' metric is mostly about data rather than time, proposing a mechanistic theory for the exponential trend. Tries to expose deeper structure underlying widely-cited AI progress chart.

entry.title: Convex Compositional Reasoning Models

author.name: Meir Roketlishvili, Semyon Semenov, Maksim Bobrin, Viktor Kovalchuk, Albert Baichorov, Abduragim Shtanchaev, Fakhri Karray, Dmitry V. Dylov, Martin Tak\'a\v{c}, Arip Asadulaev

entry.summary: Convex Compositional Energy Minimization (CCEM) parameterizes factor energies with input-convex networks for compositional reasoning, enabling deterministic projected first-order optimization.

entry.title: Efficient One-Step Diffusion Restoration Model with Compact Token Compression and Linear Attention

author.name: Bingtian Qiao, Yue Shi, Yingjie Zhou, Yong Guo, Guangtao Zhai, Jiezhang Cao

entry.summary: SANA-SR proposes one-step real-world image super-resolution using token compression and linear attention to eliminate quadratic costs at high resolution. Targets practical deployment efficiency.

entry.title: TactileReflex: Noise-Statistics-Driven Vision-Tactile Reflex Control for Force-Sensitive Manipulation

author.name: Ziyan Feng, Yulong Fu, Zheng Li, Yuxin He, Jieji Ren, Lujia Wang, Jinni Zhou, Yudong Zhong and Qiang Nie

entry.summary: TactileReflex uses noise-statistics-based calibration from sensor noise alone to derive controller thresholds for fragile container manipulation, eliminating force calibration and trial-and-error tuning. Practical robotic manipulation contribution.

entry.title: Cost-Effective Model Evaluation with Meta-Learning

author.name: Trinh Pham, Viet Huynh, Hongzhi Yin, Quoc Viet Hung Nguyen, Thanh Tam Nguyen

entry.summary: MetaEvaluator uses meta-learning over reference models for label-free, model-agnostic evaluation of unseen models without per-model retraining. Addresses growing evaluation cost in expanding model ecosystem.

entry.title: Direct Dynamic Retargeting for Humanoid Imitation Learning from Videos

author.name: Constant Roux, Ludovic De Matte\"is, Armand Jordana, Valentin Guillet, Nicolas Mansard, Olivier Stasse, Philippe Sou\`eres

entry.summary: Direct Dynamic Retargeting (DDR) generates dynamically feasible humanoid trajectories directly from monocular videos in task space using sampling-based MPC, avoiding biases from intermediate kinematic projections.

entry.title: HorizonStream: Long-Horizon Attention for Streaming 3D Reconstruction

author.name: Chong Cheng, Peilin Tao, Nanjie Yao, Guanzhi Ding, Xianda Chen, Yuansen Du, Xiaoyang Guo, Wei Yin, Weiqiang Ren, Qian Zhang, Zhengqing Chen, Hao Wang

entry.summary: HorizonStream is a long-horizon Transformer for streaming 3D reconstruction that formalizes geometric propagation as evidence influence kernels, addressing drift, jitter, and collapse in online reconstruction.

entry.title: ETCHR: Editing To Clarify and Harness Reasoning

author.name: Beichen Zhang, Yuhong Liu, Jinsong Li, Yuhang Zang, Jiaqi Wang, Dahua Lin

entry.summary: ETCHR uses a dedicated image editing model coupled with an understanding model for 'think with images' multimodal reasoning, addressing language-side and generation-side gaps. From Shanghai AI Lab/CUHK.

entry.title: POTR: Post-Training 3DGS Compression

author.name: Bert Ramlot, Martijn Courteaux, Peter Lambert, Glenn Van Wallendael

entry.summary: POTR is a post-training compression codec for 3D Gaussian Splatting using a novel pruning approach that achieves 2-4x fewer splats and 1.5-2x faster inference.

entry.title: From Abstraction to Instantiation: Learning Behavioral Representation for Vision-Language-Action Model

author.name: Bing Hu, Zaijing Li, Rui Shao, Junda Chen, April Hua Liu, Wei-Shi Zheng, Liqiang Nie

entry.summary: BehaviorVLA learns temporally coherent behavioral representations using causal Mamba-based encoder for VLA robotic manipulation, addressing distribution shift issues.

entry.title: Evaluating Large Language Models in a Complex Hidden Role Game

author.name: Niklas Bauer

entry.summary: Evaluates LLMs in the social deduction game Secret Hitler, introducing metrics for deception, role identification, and game state impact, finding CoT and memory don't help much.

entry.title: From Simulation to Discovery: AI Enabled Probabilistic Emulation of Mechanistic Crop Systems

author.name: Mojdeh Saadati, Juan Panelo, Gustavo Visentini, Soumik Sarkar, Carlos Messina, Baskar Ganapathysubramanian

entry.summary: Probabilistic neural emulator of the APSIM crop model trained on 2M simulations, achieving R²=0.93 across 13 outputs while reducing computation by orders of magnitude.

entry.title: Expressive Power of Deep Homomorphism Networks over Relational Databases

author.name: Moritz Sch\"onherr, Balder ten Cate, Maurice Funk, Benny Kimelfeld, Carsten Lutz, Arie Soeteman

entry.summary: Establishes precise expressive power results for Deep Homomorphism Networks over relational databases by relating them to fragments of first-order logic.

entry.title: BOHM: Zero-Cost Hierarchical Attribution for Compound AI Systems

author.name: Joss Armstrong

entry.summary: BOHM extracts hierarchical attribution trees directly from routing weights of compound AI systems, providing zero-cost alternative to Shapley-based attribution methods.

entry.title: MedExpMem: Adapting Experience Memory for Differential Diagnosis

author.name: Qianhan Feng, Zhongzhen Huang, Yakun Zhu, Yannian Gu, Winnie Chiu Wing Chu, Xiaofan Zhang, and Qi Dou

entry.summary: MedExpMem equips medical VLMs with experience memory of past diagnostic failures organized as pairwise differential notes, accumulating differential diagnosis expertise.

entry.title: SciAtlas: A Large-Scale Knowledge Graph for Automated Scientific Research

author.name: Shuofei Qiao, Yunxiang Wei, Jiazheng Fan, Bin Wu, Busheng Zhang, Mengru Wang, Yuqi Zhu, Ningyu Zhang, Keyan Ding, Qiang Zhang, Huajun Chen

entry.summary: SciAtlas is a large-scale multidisciplinary academic knowledge graph integrating 43M+ papers for automated scientific research, addressing limitations of keyword and vector retrieval.

entry.title: SCRIPT: Scalable Diffusion Policy with Multi-stage Training for Language-driven Physics-Based Humanoid Control

author.name: Jingyan Zhang, Han Liang, Ruichi Zhang, Bin Li, Juze Zhang, Xin Chen, Jingya Wang, Lan Xu, and Jingyi Yu

entry.summary: SCRIPT is a scalable diffusion policy with multi-stage training using a Joint Action-State-Text Diffusion Transformer for language-driven physics-based humanoid control.

entry.title: Agentic-VLA: Efficient Online Adaptation for Vision-Language-Action Models

author.name: Ruofan Jin and Zaixi Zhang

entry.summary: Agentic-VLA enables online adaptation of Vision-Language-Action models via adaptive reward synthesis, language-guided exploration, and curriculum learning for novel environments.

entry.title: From Residuals to Reasons: LLM-Guided Mechanism Inference from Tabular Data

author.name: Mohammad R. Rezaei, Rahul G. Krishnan

entry.summary: MARICL uses LLM agents to analyze base-model residuals, hypothesize missing structure, and refine predictions iteratively, anchoring LLM predictions to narrow the search space.

entry.title: Suicide Risk Assessment from AI-powered Video Surveillance: An Interpretable Framework for Prevention in Metro Stations

author.name: Safwen Naimi, Wassim Bouachir, Guillaume-Alexandre Bilodeau, Brian Mishara

entry.summary: Introduces an interpretable framework for suicide risk assessment from metro station surveillance video, jointly modeling passenger behavior, spatial context, and temporal dynamics. First formalization of this task with applied societal impact.

entry.title: Graph Alignment Topology as an Inductive Bias for Grounding Detection

author.name: Paul Landes, Pranav Herur, Adam Cross, Jimeng Sun

entry.summary: Constructs aligned bipartite graphs between reference documents and LLM outputs, training graph neural networks to detect hallucinations. Uses alignment topology as inductive bias.

entry.title: Verified Task-Space Motion Planning Under Joint-Space Constraints

author.name: Hanjiang Hu, Changliu Liu, Yebin Wang

entry.summary: Computes certifiably reachable Cartesian hyperrectangles for manipulator motion planning under joint constraints using SDP and S-procedure. Provides safety guarantees for reactive planners.

entry.title: MadEvolve: Evolutionary Optimization of Trading Systems with Large Language Models

author.name: Yurii Kvasiuk, Tianyi Li, Owen Colegrove, Moritz M\"unchmeyer

entry.summary: Applies LLM-driven evolutionary algorithm optimization (MadEvolve, inspired by Alpha-Evolve) to algorithmic Bitcoin trading strategies, evolving features and execution strategy. Shows significant backtesting improvements.

entry.title: Smoothed Elicitation Complexity for Approximate $\Gamma$-calibration of Discrete Classification Tasks

author.name: Jessica Finocchiaro, Victor Ganson, Drona Khurana

entry.summary: Develops smoothed elicitation complexity for approximate Γ-calibration of multiclass classifiers, reducing complexity from exponential in classes to polynomial in property dimension. Theoretical calibration advance.

entry.title: The Deterministic Horizon: Impossibility Results as Design Specifications for Trustworthy AI Systems

author.name: Dongxin Guo

entry.summary: Thesis claims architecture alone sets a 'Deterministic Horizon' (~19-31 reasoning depth) ceiling on transformer accuracy that training cannot exceed. Bold theoretical claim with empirical measurements across 12 architectures.

entry.title: PIMbot: A Self-Adaptive Attack Framework for Adversarial Manipulation of Multi-Robot Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Zexin Li, Ziliang Zhang, Hyoseung Kim, and Cong Liu

entry.summary: PIMbot adversarial attack framework for multi-robot reinforcement learning combining incentive manipulation and policy manipulation with adaptive multi-objective controller. Studies social dilemma manipulation.

entry.title: A measurement substrate for agentic Kubernetes operations: Methodology and a case study in retrieval-compounding falsification

author.name: Joshua Odmark, Gideon Rubin, Deon van der Vyver

entry.summary: Closed-loop measurement framework injecting faults into Kubernetes clusters to evaluate autonomous operations agents against ground truth. Addresses verification gap for ops agents.

entry.title: Millimeter-wave Imaging for Anthropometric Body Measurement

author.name: Miriam Senne, Benjamin D. Killeen, Christoph Baur, Nassir Navab, Azade Farshad

entry.summary: Optimization-based framework recovering 3D human shape and anthropometric measurements from mmWave radar volumetric data. Privacy-preserving alternative to optical scanning that works through clothing.

entry.title: The Efficiency Frontier: A Unified Framework for Cost-Performance Optimization in LLM Context Management

author.name: Binqi Shen, Lier Jin, Hanyu Cai, Lan Hu, Yuting Xin

entry.summary: Unified framework modeling LLM context strategy selection as deployment-aware optimization jointly accounting for performance, token cost, and preprocessing reuse. Provides amortized cost modeling for deployment decisions.

entry.title: KAPLAN: Kolmogorov-Arnold Prognostic Learnable Activation Networks for Survival Analysis

author.name: Stelios Boulitsakis Logothetis, Angela Wood, Pietro Li \`o

entry.summary: KAPLAN-HR: Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks for survival analysis using B-splines for nonparametric hazard estimation jointly over covariates and time. Establishes convergence rates depending only on KAN smoothness.

entry.title: Dreaming Smoothly and Sample Efficiently with Gradient Penalized Latent Dynamics

author.name: Romil V. Sonigra (1), P. R. Kumar (1) ((1) Texas A&M University)

entry.summary: GPLD applies row-wise Jacobian penalty to DreamerV3's posterior latent distribution to encourage smooth transition learning, interpreted as continuous-latent analog of finite-difference smoothing. Improves sample efficiency on DeepMind Control.

entry.title: Four Simple Proprioceptive Estimators for Legged Robots

author.name: Frank Dellaert, Chiyun Noh, Varun Agrawal, and Ayoung Kim

entry.summary: Develops a sequence of legged robot state estimators leveraging foot contacts to mitigate IMU drift, from invariant EKF to factor-graph smoothers. Pedagogical/reproducibility-focused contribution by Dellaert.

entry.title: LLM Sparsity Prior for Robust Feature Selection

author.name: Caleb Skinner and Yihan Guo and Meng Li

entry.summary: Introduces LLM Sparsity Prior, a Bayesian framework integrating LLM-generated weights as prior inclusion probabilities for spike-and-slab variable selection, robust to weight inaccuracies. Improves on LLM-Lasso.

entry.title: CoReVAD: A Contextual Reasoning Framework for Training-Free Video Anomaly Detection

author.name: Hyeongmuk Lim, Youngbum Hur

entry.summary: CoReVAD enables training-free video anomaly detection with a single frozen VLM via contextual reasoning, avoiding instruction tuning or external LLMs.

entry.title: Exploiting Longitudinal Context in Clinician-Verified Interactive Lesion Tracking

author.name: Yannick Kirchhoff, Maximilian Rokuss, Daniel Philipp Mertens, David F\"uller, Benjamin Hamm, Andreas Schreyer, Oliver Ritter, Klaus Maier-Hein

entry.summary: Verified Tracking paradigm for clinician-verified longitudinal lesion tracking in CT, combining registration prompts with baseline lesion appearance via spatial-temporal fusion. Clinically relevant.

entry.title: Classical State Preparation for Variational Quantum Algorithms via Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Gino Kwun, Dhanvi Bharadwaj, Gokul Subramanian Ravi

entry.summary: CRiSP uses transformer-policy MCTS via self-play to insert Clifford gates as warm-starts for variational quantum algorithms, addressing barren plateaus.

entry.title: When Symptoms Are Not Enough: Evidence-Weighting Patterns in Large Language Model Psychiatric Screening

author.name: Jianfeng Zhu, Megan Korhummel, Ruoming Jin, Karin G. Coifman

entry.summary: SCID-anchored benchmark of 555 interviews for psychiatric screening by 5 LLMs, examining how false negatives reflect evidence-weighting patterns across demographics.

entry.title: Empirical Bayes Conformal Prediction for Vision and Language Models

author.name: Jiapeng Zeng, Yogesh Prabhu, Zhanpeng Zeng, Michael A. Newton, Vikas Singh

entry.summary: Empirical Bayes conformal prediction using r-values to convert score variability into uncertainty-informed nonconformity scores for vision and language models.

entry.title: Label-Efficient Dataset Pruning via Semi-Supervised Pseudo-Labeling

author.name: Yeseul Cho, Baekrok Shin, Changmin Kang, Chulhee Yun

entry.summary: SemiPrune: label-efficient dataset pruning combining small labeled subset with semi-supervised pseudo-labeling, decoupling pruning from pretrained features.

entry.title: Beyond Normal References: Discriminative Few-Shot Anomaly Detection

author.name: Huan Wang, Jun Shen, Jun Yan, Guansong Pang

entry.summary: IDEAL: discriminative few-shot anomaly detection leveraging both normal and anomalous references via Normal Variation Eraser to learn intrinsic deviation patterns.

entry.title: Self-supervised Adversarial Purification for Graph Neural Networks

author.name: Woohyun Lee, Hogun Park

entry.summary: GPR-GAE: self-supervised graph autoencoder purifier with multiple Generalized PageRank filters that decouples robustness from classification in defending GNNs against adversarial attacks.

entry.title: Signal Temporal Logic Motion Planning via Graphs of Convex Sets

author.name: Yu Chen, Ancheng Hou, Mingyang Feng, Xiao Yu and Xiang Yin

entry.summary: STL motion planning combining timed-automata reasoning with graphs of convex sets to produce smooth Bézier-spline trajectories satisfying signal temporal logic specs.

entry.title: RelPrism: A Multi-Faceted Pre-training Framework with Self-Generated Tasks for Relational Databases

author.name: Jinyu Yang, Cheng Yang, Junze Chen, Zedi Liu, Muhan Zhang, Hanyang Peng, Chuan Shi

entry.summary: RelPrism: multi-faceted self-supervised pre-training framework with self-generated tasks for relational databases, capturing both interaction patterns and intrinsic attributes.

entry.title: Learning-Augmented Online Scheduling with Parsimonious Preemption

author.name: Mugen Blue, Sungjin Im, Alexander Lindermayr

entry.summary: First systematic study of learning-augmented online scheduling that limits preemption count while optimizing latency, achieving O(1)-competitive algorithms with O(1) preemptions.

entry.title: Coloring the Noise: Adversarial Sobolev Alignment for Faithful Image Super Resolution

author.name: Hongbo Wang, Huaibo Huang, Pin Wang, Jinhua Hao, Chao Zhou, Ran He

entry.summary: ASASR uses Sobolev-induced Riemannian geometry with colored noise for image super-resolution, addressing spectral misalignment in DPO-based generative SR. Theoretically grounded.

entry.title: Coupled Training with Privileged Information and Unlabeled Data

author.name: Jiahao Shi, Omar Hagrass, Jason M. Klusowski

entry.summary: Joint training method for using privileged training-time information that selectively benefits the deployment model, with theoretical guarantees on when joint training helps over two-stage approaches.

entry.title: DepthAgent: Towards Better Universal Depth Estimation via Sample-wise Expert Selection

author.name: Jie Zhu, Girish Chandar Ganesan, Xiaoming Liu

entry.summary: DepthAgent uses a vision-language agent to select among depth experts based on camera geometry (perspective/fisheye/panoramic), exploiting sample-wise expert complementarity for monocular depth estimation.

entry.title: Ontological Knowledge Blocks: Executable Compliance and Profile-Based Validation for Trustworthy AI Systems

author.name: Aasish Kumar Sharma, Julian M. Kunkel

entry.summary: Ontological Knowledge Blocks (OKBs) compile regulatory obligations into machine-checkable constraints over evidence graphs using SHACL/RDF/OWL/PROV-O for AI compliance.

entry.title: Efficient Learned Image Compression without Entropy Coding

author.name: Hao Cao, Wenqi Guo, Zhijin Qin, Jungong Han

entry.summary: EF-LIC achieves learned image compression without entropy coding using unconstrained vector quantization and context-conditioned autoregressive transforms, removing the sequential coding bottleneck.

entry.title: Sparse Compositional Flow Matching by geometric assembly from motion primitives

author.name: Yan Tang, Yuanbo Tang, Tingyu Cao, Shaolun Huang, Yang Li

entry.summary: Sparse Compositional Flow Matching for embodied trajectories using reusable motion primitives as latent compositional structure, aligning with subtask boundaries.

entry.title: CHASD: Language Increment-Calibrated Contrastive Decoding against Hallucination in LVLMs

author.name: Xiaoyi Huang, Kejia Zhang, Zhiming Luo

entry.summary: CHASD performs token-specific contrastive decoding to mitigate object hallucinations in large vision-language models, applying calibration only at high-risk tokens.

entry.title: SCOPE: Simulating Cross-game Operations in Playable Environments for FPS World Models

author.name: Zizhao Tong, Hongfeng Lai, Zeqing Wang, Zhaohu Xing, Kexu Cheng, Haoran Xu, Zhao Pu, Shangwen Zhu, Ruili Feng, Jian Zhao, Yan Zhang, Hao Tang, Yeying Jin, Ling Shao

entry.summary: SCOPE inserts conditioning modules into transformer blocks of pretrained video diffusion models for FPS world models, separating localized weapon-region effects from global camera/movement signals.

entry.title: Prudent-Banker: No Extra Fees for Baseline Safety in Adversarial Bandits With and Without Delays

author.name: Ting Hu, Luanda Cai, Emmanouil-Vasileios Vlatakis-Gkaragkounis

entry.summary: Prudent-Banker: adversarial bandit algorithm achieving minimax-optimal regret while maintaining near-constant regret vs safe baseline, with delayed feedback handling.

entry.title: VDE: Training-Free Accelerating Rectified Flow Model via Velocity Decomposition and Estimation

author.name: Junwen Tan, Jinglin Liang, Hongyuan Chen, Shuangping Huang

entry.summary: VDE accelerates rectified flow models via velocity decomposition into parallel/orthogonal components, training-free, addressing static cache mismatch in prior caching methods.

entry.title: Joint Target-Less Intrinsic and Extrinsic Camera-LiDAR Calibration using Deep Point Correspondences

author.name: Simon Bultmann, Daniele Cattaneo, and Abhinav Valada

entry.summary: First fully target-less pipeline for joint camera intrinsics and camera-LiDAR extrinsics calibration using deep pixel-point correspondences, handling unknown distortion via SfM initialization.

entry.title: What Linear Probes Miss: Multi-View Probing for Weight-Space Learning

author.name: Eunwoo Heo, Kyeongkook Seo, Jaejun Yoo

entry.summary: MVProbe: multi-perspective probing framework for weight-space learning that captures higher-order row-column correlations beyond single-view probing limitations. Addresses 'Model Jungle' problem.

entry.title: Sample-wise Targeted Adversarial Attacks on Test-time Adaptation

author.name: Phuc Duc Nguyen, Quang Duc Nguyen

entry.summary: Sample-wise targeted adversarial attacks on test-time adaptation that misclassify only triggered inputs while preserving global label distribution to evade detection. Meta-learning-based.

entry.title: Naturalistic measure of social norms alignment

author.name: Yevhen Kostiuk, Kenneth Enevoldsen, Peter Bjerregaard Vahlstrup, M\'arton Kardos, Kristoffer Nielbo

entry.summary: Framework for measuring social norm alignment in naturalistic free-form settings via solution matching, with stated/explicit agreement metrics on dataset of 3K dilemmas.

entry.title: Onsager-Machlup Posterior Transport for Deep Gaussian Processes

author.name: Jian Xu, Delu Zeng, John Paisley, Qibin Zhao

entry.summary: OM-Path frames Deep GP inference as posterior transport via probability-flow ODE with Onsager-Machlup action regularization. Avoids ELBO and MCMC for inducing variable inference.

entry.title: S$^3$GNN: Efficient Global Mixing and Local Message Passing for Long-Range Graph Learning

author.name: Dai Shi, Luke Thompson, Linhan Luo, Lequan Lin, Andi Han, Junbin Gao, Jos\'e Miguel Hern\'andez Lobato

entry.summary: S³GNN combines lightweight global spectral mixing with local message passing to mitigate oversquashing without restrictive assumptions. Proposes a more practical alternative to existing spectral GNN approaches.

entry.title: Automated Random Embedding for Practical Bayesian Optimization with Unknown Effective Dimension

author.name: Hong Qian, Xiang Shu, Xiang Xia, Xuhui Liu, Yangde Fu, Bei Liang, Huibin Wang, Liang Dou

entry.summary: Dynamic Shared Embedding for Bayesian Optimization automates subspace dimensionality selection without expert priors or trial-and-error. Addresses fundamental challenge in high-dimensional BO.

entry.title: MDS-DETR: DETR with Masked Duplicate Suppressor

author.name: Chanho Lee, Seunghee Koh, Yunho Jeon and Junmo Kim

entry.summary: MDS-DETR uses confidence-based causal masking to combine one-to-one and one-to-many supervision in a single decoder for object detection. Eliminates auxiliary decoders while preserving training benefits.

entry.title: ComPose: When to Trust Hands for Object Pose Tracking

author.name: Jisu Shin, Junoh Lee, JunGyu Lee, Inhwan Bae, Dohyeon Lee, Hokyun Im, Youngwoon Lee, Hae-Gon Jeon

entry.summary: ComPose treats hand motions as complementary cues rather than occluders for 6DoF object pose tracking from RGB video. Combines object and hand cues from foundation models in a unified pipeline.

entry.title: When One Point Is Not Enough: Addressing Ambiguous Instances in Dimensionality Reduction by Splitting

author.name: Diede P.M. van der Hoorn, Alessio Arleo, Fernando V. Paulovich

entry.summary: Identifies ambiguous instances—data points similar to multiple dissimilar neighborhoods—as a key source of visual artifacts in dimensionality reduction, and proposes splitting them into multiple visual points. Novel observation in DR visualization.

entry.title: HARNESS-LM: A Three-Phase Training Recipe for Harnessing SLMs in Sponsored Search Retrieval

author.name: Vipul Gupta, Shikhar Mohan, Lakshya Kumar, Pranjal Chitale, Nikit Begwani, Amit Singh, Manik Varma

entry.summary: HARNESS-LM is a three-phase training recipe distilling billion-parameter retrievers (Qwen3-Embedding) into sub-600M models for sponsored search retrieval. Addresses production latency vs quality trade-off.

entry.title: Benchmarking Google Embeddings 2 against Open-Source Models for Multilingual Dense Retrieval and RAG Systems

author.name: Stefano Cirillo, Domenico Desiato, Giuseppe Polese, Giandomenico Solimando

entry.summary: Benchmarks Google Embeddings 2 against five open-source embedding models on retrieval and RAG. Finds GE2 best on accuracy but 14x slower; mE5-L offers strong latency-quality trade-off.

entry.title: How Human-Like Are Large Language Models? A Register-Aware Linguistic Evaluation Framework

author.name: Bj\"orn Nieth (1 and 4), Marianna Gracheva (2), Michaela Mahlberg (2 and 3), Bjoern Eskofier (1 and 3 and 5 and 6), Emmanuelle Salin (1) ((1) Department Artificial Intelligence in Biomedical Engineering (AIBE) FAU Erlangen-N\"urnberg Germany, (2) Department of Digital Humanities and Social Studies (DHSS) FAU Erlangen-N\"urnberg Germany, (3) University of Birmingham United Kingdom, (4) Chair of AI-supported Therapy Decisions LMU M\"unchen Munich Germany, (5) Munich Center for Machine Learning (MCML) Munich Germany, (6) Institute of AI for Health Helmholtz Zentrum M\"unchen Neuherberg Germany)

entry.summary: Register-aware framework evaluating LLM human-likeness via two-sample tests on linguistic feature distributions against context-specific human reference corpora. Corpus-linguistic evaluation perspective.

entry.title: One Policy, Infinite NPCs: Persona-Traceable Shared RL Policies for Scalable Game Agents

author.name: Yoosung Hong

entry.summary: PCSP trains a single RL policy conditioned on frozen LLM persona embeddings for 300+ NPCs, achieving 17x above chance persona identification and 22x faster than LLM-as-policy. Practical for game NPC scaling.

entry.title: OnePred: Next-Query Prediction via Recursive Intent Memory in Multi-Turn Conversations

author.name: Jiangwang Chen, Bowen Zhang, Zixin Song, Jiazheng Kang, Xiao Yang, Da Zhu, Guanjun Jiang

entry.summary: OnePred predicts user's next query in multi-turn dialogues by tracking evolving intent trajectory rather than re-reading raw history, addressing efficiency-quality trade-off. Targets proactive LLM interaction.

entry.title: Optimal Dimension-Free Sampling for Regularized Classification

author.name: Meysam Alishahi and Alexander Munteanu and Simon Omlor and Jeff M. Phillips

entry.summary: Theoretical paper proving optimal dimension-free sampling bounds for regularized classification with broad classes of Lipschitz losses (logistic, hinge, ReLU). Establishes tight upper and lower bounds.

entry.title: SeedER: Seed-and-Expand Retrieval from Knowledge Graphs

author.name: Hamed Shirzad, Frederik Wenkel, Dominique Beaini, Danica J. Sutherland and Emmanuel Noutahi

entry.summary: SeedER is a knowledge graph retrieval framework using lightweight seeding plus RL-trained graph-aware expansion, balancing the cost-expressivity tradeoff in agent-based KG exploration. Relevant for KG-RAG systems.

entry.title: LLM-driven design of physics-constrained constitutive models: two agents are better than one

author.name: Marius Tacke, Matthias Busch, Kian Abdolazizi, Jonas Eichinger, Kevin Linka, Roland Aydin, Christian Cyron

entry.summary: Multi-agent LLM system (Creator + Inspector) for generating physics-constrained constitutive models for materials, with the Inspector auditing against nine physical laws. Demonstrates value of multi-agent verification in scientific ML.

entry.title: Beyond Binary Edits Robust Multimodal Knowledge Editing with Adversarial Subspace Alignment

author.name: Haoyuan Wang, Xiaohao Liu, Jiajie Su, Jianmao Xiao, Chaochao Chen

entry.summary: Proposes adversarial subspace alignment for robust multimodal knowledge editing in MLLMs, formalizing knowledge units of semantically equivalent inputs to improve generality of edits. Addresses key limitation in current MLLM editing.

entry.title: Leveraging Foundation Models for Causal Generative Modeling

author.name: Aneesh Komanduri, Xintao Wu

entry.title: Human-in-the-Loop Multi-Agent Ventilator Decision Support with Contextual Bandit Preference Learning

entry.title: RS2AD-LiDAR: End-to-End Autonomous Driving LiDAR Data Generation from Roadside Sensor Observations

entry.title: Rethinking Transfer Learning for Industrial Inspection: DINOv3 vs. ImageNet Pretraining Across RGB and X-ray Tasks

entry.summary: Probabilistic graph-based approach for forecasting air traffic complexity in UK airspace using relevant aircraft pair interactions as a proxy for controller workload. Domain-specific application with iterative ATCO feedback.

entry.title: SFG-ROS: A Resource-Aware Framework for Dense Multi-Agent Perception

author.name: Constantin Blessing and Elias Geiger and Jakob H\"aringer and Dennis Grewe and Markus Enzweiler

entry.summary: SFG-ROS is a resource-aware ROS 2 framework for multi-agent perception with schema-driven traffic routing and on-demand centralized decoding. Engineering contribution for robot fleet deployments.

entry.title: Online Hand Gesture Recognition Using 3D Convolutional Neural Networks

author.name: Yinghao Qin, Tijana Timotijevic

entry.summary: Online hand gesture recognition using 3D CNNs with sliding window approach trained on Jester dataset, achieving 98%+ detection and 90%+ classification accuracy.

entry.title: Thermal transmittance prediction based on the application of artificial neural networks on heat flux method results

author.name: Sanjin Gumbarevi\'c, Bojan Milovanovi\'c, Mergim Ga\v{s}i, Marina Bagari\'c

entry.summary: Uses neural networks to predict thermal transmittance (U-values) of building envelopes from heat flux measurements, addressing slow in-situ measurement durations for energy renovation assessments.

entry.title: An AI-Driven Framework for Energy-Efficient Environmental Monitoring in Smart Cities Using Edge Intelligence

author.name: Yichen Liu, Imam Akintomiwa Akinlade, Xiaochong Jiang, Wenting Yang, Shiqi Yang

entry.summary: Edge AI framework using TinyML and context-aware adaptive sensor activation for energy-efficient environmental monitoring in smart cities.

entry.title: KPI2KVI: A Multi Agent Workflow for Calculating Key Value Indicators from Service Descriptions

author.name: Masoud Shokrnezhad, Tarik Taleb, Yan Chen, and Qize Guo

entry.summary: KPI2KVI uses a deterministic multi-agent LLM workflow to convert natural-language service descriptions into computed Key Value Indicator estimates.

entry.title: The Cognitive Kardashev Scale: Quantifying the Material Envelope of Civilisational Computation

author.name: Sachin Sharma

entry.summary: Proposes a Cognitive Kardashev Scale quantifying the maximum AI compute civilizations can sustain across power tiers, anchoring on 2024-2026 hardware efficiency.

entry.title: Mediative Fuzzy Logic: From Type-1 Foundations to Type-2, Type-3 and Quantum Extensions

author.name: Oscar Montiel Ross

entry.summary: Develops theoretical foundations for Mediative Fuzzy Logic, extending it from type-1 to type-2, type-3, and quantum settings with formal logical properties. Niche theoretical contribution to fuzzy logic systems.

entry.title: Human-Centered Learning Mechanics: A Dynamical Framework for Entropy-Regulated Representation Learning

author.name: Kim Phuc Tran

entry.summary: Proposes Human-Centered Learning Mechanics framework treating training as open dynamical system with information-force entropy regularization. Theoretical proposal with limited empirical grounding.

entry.title: A Reproducible Universal Dependencies-Style Pipeline for Katharevousa Greek Parliamentary Text

author.name: George Mikros and Fotios Fitsilis

entry.summary: Reproducible NLP pipeline for parsing Katharevousa Greek parliamentary text using Universal Dependencies. Compares mBERT, XLM-R, and custom Stanza models on 1,697-sentence corpus.

entry.title: DRL-Driven Edge-Aware Utility Optimization for Multi-Slice 6G Networks

author.name: Khaled M. Naguib, Soumaya Cherkaoui, Mahmoud M. Elmessalawy, Ahmed M. Abd El-Haleem and Ibrahim I. Ibrahim

entry.summary: DQN-based intelligent resource allocation and edge caching framework for 6G O-RAN networks supporting VR services. Domain-specific application of DRL.

entry.title: Mode-Shape Expansion Using Physics-Constrained Gaussian Process Regression

author.name: Farid Ghahari

entry.summary: Physics-constrained Gaussian process regression framework for reconstructing structural mode shapes from sparse sensor data, with mass-orthogonality penalty. Niche structural engineering contribution.

entry.title: A Fine-Tuned BERT Classifier for Personal-Letter Titles in Late-Ming and Early-Qing Collected Works

author.name: Queenie Luo

entry.summary: Fine-tuned BERT classifier (Lepton) for distinguishing personal letters from prefaces in Classical Chinese wenji table-of-contents, deployed at scale to identify ~55,000 letters. Domain digital humanities application.

entry.title: Robust OT-Guided Generative Residual Domain Adaptation for Bike-Sharing Demand Prediction under Temporal Domain Shift

author.name: Yiming Ma

entry.summary: Gen-ROTDA: optimal-transport-guided residual domain adaptation for bike-sharing demand prediction across years. Niche temporal domain shift application.

entry.title: Accelerating Divisible Load Processing Through Machine Learning: A Practical Framework for Large-Scale Workloads

author.name: Bharadwaj Veeravalli

entry.summary: Feedforward NN trained on 100K synthetic configurations to predict optimal Divisible Load Theory processing times in Single-Level Tree Networks.

entry.title: A Novel Approach for the Counting of Wood Logs Using cGANs and Image Processing Techniques

author.name: Jo\~ao VC Mazzochin, Giovani Bernardes Vitor, Gustavo Tiecker, Elioenai MF Diniz, Gilson A Oliveira, Marcelo Trentin, \'Erick O Rodrigues

entry.summary: cGAN-based segmentation method combined with image processing and connected components for counting eucalyptus logs in images, with a public 466-image dataset of ~13K logs. Domain-specific application.

entry.title: Machine learning applied to emerald gemstone grading: framework proposal and creation of a public dataset

author.name: FB Pena, D Crabi, Sandro C Izidoro, \'Erick O Rodrigues, G Bernardes

entry.summary: ML framework with custom imaging chamber for automated emerald grading, replacing subjective gemologist judgments. Includes a public dataset.

entry.title: Leveraging Large Language Models for Sentiment Analysis: Multi-Modal Analysis of Decentraland's MANA Token

author.name: Xintong Wu, Peiting Tsai, Jing Yuan, Michael Yu, Greg Sun, Luyao Zhang

entry.summary: Combines BERT sentiment analysis of Discord with multimodal financial features in LSTM models to predict MANA cryptocurrency token returns.

entry.title: Improved Vision-to-Chart Buoy Association with Learned World-to-Image Projection

author.name: Borja Carrillo-Perez (Arquimea Research Center)

entry.summary: Lightweight modification to a DETR-based fusion transformer for vision-to-chart buoy association in marine challenge, adding explicit pixel projection MLP. Narrow challenge submission.

entry.title: An Efficient Machine Learning-based Framework for Detection and Prevention of Frauds in Telecom Networks

author.name: Praveen Hegde, Mishal Shah

entry.summary: Evaluates ML models for telecom fraud detection on Call Detail Record data using SMOTE balancing and standard classifiers.

entry.title: Taxing Small Cars To Improve MPG

author.name: jefftk

entry.summary: LessWrong blog post analyzing how US fuel economy regulations (CAFE) inadvertently incentivize manufacturers to make larger vehicles by tying mpg targets to vehicle footprint. Policy analysis, not AI research.

entry.title: Neurogastronomic Phenomenology for Advanced Beginners, Applied and Pure

author.name: Lorxus

entry.summary: LessWrong post on neurogastronomic phenomenology and theory of flavor pairing, including hyperbolic geometry of olfactory space. Off-topic for AI research.

entry.title: Belief as Psychosis

author.name: MillardJMelnyk

entry.summary: LessWrong post speculating that belief is a symptom of psychosis, framed as a hypothesis backed by a Claude conversation. Speculative philosophical commentary.

entry.title: Heretical Pasta

author.name: jefftk

entry.summary: LessWrong blog post sharing personal pasta cooking opinions. Off-topic for AI research analysis.

entry.title: Research Summary: May 24, 2026

author.name: AATF AI News Aggregator

entry.summary:
Today's posts emphasize AI safety research, governance analysis, and foundational philosophy, with limited frontier model research.

Safety & Alignment Research:

  • Owain Evans publishes a primer and reading list on out-of-context reasoning (OOCR) in LLMs, surveying cases where models combine training-time facts in the forward pass without chain-of-thought
  • An empirical study tests whether LLMs refuse uplift requests on mirror life, probing the gap between official WMD/CBRN classifications and emerging biothreats
  • A hands-on writeup attempts Jane Street's LLM backdoor detection challenge using white-box methods on fine-tuned Qwen2.5-7B and DeepSeek-V3 models

Governance & Strategic Analysis:

  • Analysis of how Anthropic's Claude-Mythos-Preview release should update beliefs about AI-enabled coup risk given its cyber capabilities
  • Translation of a PLA Daily article on AGI's implications for warfare, illuminating Chinese military strategic thinking
  • Commentary on AI safety pipeline leakage and a call for populist political organizing on AI governance

Philosophy & Foundations: Posts sketch unified frameworks for Bayesian priors and anthropics, argue Boltzmann brain and Doomsday puzzles need no explanation, and critique 'single genius' framings of AGI cooperation dynamics.

entry.title: Out-of-Context Reasoning (OOCR) in LLMs: A Short Primer and Reading List

author.name: Owain_Evans

entry.summary: Owain Evans provides a primer and reading list on out-of-context reasoning (OOCR) in LLMs - cases where models combine facts in the forward pass without verbalized chain-of-thought. Highly relevant to alignment given implications for hidden reasoning and deceptive capabilities.

entry.title: PLA Daily Translation: Reflections on Warfare Brought by AGI

author.name: eeeee

entry.summary: Translation and analysis of a January 2025 PLA Daily article by Chinese military authors on AGI's implications for warfare, with framing context arguing China is not actually racing for frontier AGI. Useful primary source for AI race discourse.

entry.title: Can Large Language Models Identify Novel Threats? Part 1: Mirror Life and the Classification Gap

author.name: Failfinder70

entry.summary: Tests whether LLMs refuse uplift requests on mirror life - a real emerging biothreat not yet officially classified as WMD/CBRN. Examines the gap between safety training and unclassified novel threats.

entry.title: How should we update on AI-enabled coups post-Mythos?

author.name: boygirlseating

entry.summary: Analyzes how Anthropic's Claude-Mythos-Preview (a model deemed too dangerous, with major cyber capabilities) should update beliefs about AI-enabled coup risks. Argues Mythos lowers minimum coalition size for targeted disruption while concentrating decision-power in private actors.

entry.title: Looking for backdoors in Jane Street LLMs

author.name: Cipolla

entry.summary: Hands-on writeup of attempting Jane Street's LLM backdoor detection challenge using white-box methods on fine-tuned Qwen2.5-7B and DeepSeek-V3 models. Reports partial success after activation/prompting approaches failed.

entry.title: Probabilities are not the right concept

author.name: David Matolcsi

entry.summary: First post in a planned sequence sketching a unified framework for Bayesian priors, probability foundations, anthropics, and infinite ethics. Synthesizes existing work from Christiano, Garrabrant, Carlsmith and others.

entry.title: Your Left Brain Doesn't Trade With Your Right

author.name: Alexander Gietelink Oldenziel

entry.summary: Critique of 'single genius model' framing of AGI, arguing economists miss that AGI may transcend the cooperation/specialization paradigm by integrating multiple perspectives in one mind. Conceptual essay on AGI nature.

entry.title: Goodhart's Law and a Minimum Viable Sugarscape: Karpathy Pattern ABM Autoresearch

author.name: Raven Of Empire

entry.summary: An informal LessWrong post describing a 'vibe coded' experiment to use LLM agents to iterate on minimal agent-based models (Sugarscape), with a Karpathy-style ablation harness. Explores LLM-driven autoresearch but is preliminary and not rigorous.

entry.title: Boltzmann brains, like Doomsday, require no explaining

author.name: Steffee

entry.summary: Philosophical post arguing that the Doomsday Argument and Boltzmann brain anthropic puzzles don't actually require explanation, challenging Yudkowsky's recent post. Engages with anthropic reasoning.

entry.title: A political movement will save us from extinction

author.name: rohantohab

entry.summary: Founder of 'Sapiens First' argues AI safety needs a populist political movement to build societal capacity for governance. Activism-oriented post citing the (fictional in reality but in-world) Mythos model.

entry.title: The Leaky AI Safety Pipeline

author.name: Nikhil Kalidasu

entry.summary: Reflection on becoming a productive AI safety researcher, citing acceptance of an independent paper at the SiMLA workshop at ACNS 2026. Argues field should optimize the conversion pipeline from program graduates to peer-reviewed researchers.

entry.title: Capitalism is only the first of our problems

author.name: Ian Matson

entry.summary: Argues AI alignment must precede economic restructuring discussions about AI's threat to capitalism. Commentary essay.

entry.title: Low Expectancy is Not a Confidence Problem

author.name: Alex A

entry.summary: A short opinion post critiquing a procrastination framework, arguing low expectancy reflects real capability gaps rather than miscalibrated confidence. Self-help commentary.

entry.title: Veganism is Virtuous, not Obligatory

author.name: Hide

entry.summary: Philosophical essay arguing veganism is supererogatory rather than morally obligatory. Not AI-related.

entry.title:
How Humans Will Achieve Immortality
(by transcending biology and becoming machine intelligence)

author.name: SeymourJReid

entry.summary: Speculative essay proposing humans achieve immortality via gradual neural-implant cyborgization leading to mind uploading. Transhumanist commentary.

entry.title: The Fundamentals of Cogitism: Grounding Ethics in the Nature of Consciousness

author.name: ArtiFabian

entry.summary: Author presents 'Cogitism', a personal moral framework grounding ethics in consciousness. Philosophical essay with disclosed AI involvement.

entry.title: Basic principles for dressing better.

author.name: spookycat

entry.summary: Style guide for rationalist men on assembling outfits. Lifestyle content, not research.

entry.title: Research Summary: May 23, 2026

author.name: AATF AI News Aggregator

entry.summary:
Today's research and commentary cluster around post-AGI economics, AI safety methodology, and timely model evaluations, with limited novel technical contributions.

Transformative AI Economics

  • *The AI Industrial Explosion (Part 3)* models post-AGI growth by reoptimizing production recipes for cheap labor and capital-intensive factor prices.
  • *Will we really put data centers in space?* offers concrete cost/thermal analysis of orbital data centers, pushing back on speculative Musk-era claims.

AI Safety & Alignment

  • *Which technical AI safety fields are automated first?* uses feedback quality and economic incentives to predict which subfields frontier labs will automate.
  • *Counting Arguments in AI Safety* critiques goal-space counting arguments by drawing parallels to Bertrand's Paradox.
  • *We made a map of the doom debate* releases an interactive probabilistic tree of AI threat pathways from AI Safety Camp.
  • *AI is Not Normal Technology* rebuts Narayanan & Kapoor, citing biosecurity as a concrete disanalogy.

Model Reviews & Practice

  • Zvi reviews Gemini 3.5 Flash as best-at-speed but inferior to Claude Opus 4.7 and GPT-5.5 for serious work.
  • *Notes on Collaborating with Claude Opus* documents prompting patterns showing reasoned instructions improve compliance.

Strategy & Timelines

  • The proposed DIAL distribution (decision importance adjusted for leverage) reframes timelines reasoning around decision-relevant probability mass.
  • A philosophical defense of strong longtermism rounds out the field.

entry.title: The AI Industrial Explosion — Part 3: Going faster

author.name: djbinder

entry.summary: Third installment in a series modeling post-AGI economic growth, examining how reoptimizing production recipes for post-AGI factor prices (cheap labor, fast capital reproduction) would accelerate economic doubling beyond what fixed-recipe models suggest. Uses 2017 US input-output tables as baseline.

entry.title: Will we really put data centers in space?

author.name: Avi Parrack

entry.summary: Analysis of the technical and economic feasibility of orbital data centers (ODCs) for AI compute, examining whether claims by Musk and others about space-based AI are realistic. Concludes that cost-competitiveness depends almost entirely on Starship reusability achieving Falcon-like economics (~$250/kg to orbit).

entry.title: Gemini 3.5 Flash Looks Good For How Fast It Is

author.name: Zvi

entry.summary: Zvi's review of Google's recently-released Gemini 3.5 Flash, arguing it's the best at its speed point but not preferable to Opus 4.7 or GPT-5.5 for most uses. Covers other Google I/O announcements.

entry.title: Which technical AI safety fields are going to be automated first?

author.name: Chamod Kalupahana

entry.summary: Analysis of which technical AI safety subfields are most likely to be automated first by frontier labs, using feedback quality and economic incentive as the two key factors. Notes Anthropic's use of Mythos and UKAISI evaluations as early signals.

entry.title: Counting Arguments in AI Safety

author.name: Samuel Ratnam

entry.summary: Examines the structure of 'counting arguments' in AI doom reasoning (vast goal space → most goals are unfriendly), drawing parallels to Bertrand's Paradox to question whether the chosen measure is principled. Engages with prior LessWrong critiques.

entry.title: We made a map of the doom debate

author.name: Sean Herrington

entry.summary: AI Safety Camp project produced an interactive tree-structured map of AI threat pathways, allowing users to set probabilities for each branch and identify cruxes with others. Aims to systematize the P(Doom) debate by decomposing assumptions.

entry.title: AI is Not Normal Technology

author.name: Olivia Scharfman

entry.summary: Response to Narayanan and Kapoor's 'AI as Normal Technology' essay, arguing AI is fundamentally different and citing biosecurity as the most concrete catastrophic risk. Uses chess history as a parallel.

entry.title: Notes on Collaborating with Claude Opus

author.name: Nissa Seru

entry.summary: Practical notes on prompting/collaboration patterns with Claude Opus 4.7, including how reasoning behind instructions improves compliance, the value of labeled response sections, and pitfalls of negatively-framed instructions. Practitioner observations.

entry.title: Proposal for "Timelines to what": DIAL distribution

author.name: tlevin

entry.summary: Linkpost proposing the 'DIAL distribution' framework (decision importance adjusted for leverage) for reasoning about AI timelines, advocating distributions over point estimates and weighting by decision-relevance.

entry.title: Strong Longtermism Is Simply Correct

author.name: Bentham's Bulldog

entry.summary: Philosophical defense of strong longtermism, arguing the vast scale of potential future people means most expected impact of our actions concerns the long-run future. Standard utilitarian/longtermist argument with minor framing updates.

entry.title: Insurance Premiums To The Moon

author.name: PossiblyElaine

entry.summary: Discussion of rising US insurance premiums, breaking down where premium dollars go and considering causes. Not AI-related.
